raw.title: Account Executive
raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

About the Role

Build new client relationships in a defined territory, combining thoughtful account prioritization with the pace and persistence to create opportunities at scale. With a large pool of untapped accounts still to break into, you’ll build your own book of business rather than inherit a fixed set of relationships.

This role is for a hunter who sells with focus. You’ll prioritise accounts, prospect and create opportunities across multiple buying groups, run well-managed pilots, and close a steady flow of deals, with clear ownership of the relationship from first outreach through the early customer relationship. Your results are visible, you’ll help shape a newly tiered sales organisation, and you’ll grow within a clearer individual contributor progression path.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Own a defined territory, prioritise accounts, and win new clients.

  • Prospect and create opportunities across the buying groups within each target account, and build a reliable, repeatable pipeline.

  • Qualify quickly and run well-managed pilot processes from start to close.

  • Communicate 9fin’s value proposition to clients through tailored demos.

  • Negotiate and close new business, including multi-year agreements where it makes sense.

  • Build account plans that map the organisation and identify teams and desks to expand into.

  • Keep clear CRM records and forecast accurately.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Enablement, and Rev Ops so deals move cleanly from pilot to onboarding.

  • Share ideas with senior management to shape Commercial team processes and best practices.

  • Bring client feedback to Product so the platform keeps improving for our users.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 2+ years of relevant Account Executive experience ideally in capital markets and/or Fintech SaaS.

  • Have a hunter mindset and a track record of generating your own pipeline and exceeding targets, ideally in a high-volume sales environment.

  • Have a good knowledge of financial markets and the ability to build strong relationships within the 9fin community.

  • Can plan and prioritise across many opportunities at once, with accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly in writing and in conversation.

  • Build trust across a matrixed commercial organization and partner effectively with Customer Success, Content and Product.

  • Have an existing network in the leveraged finance community (helpful but not required).

  • Thrive in ambitious, fast-moving environments where expectations are high, opportunities are abundant, and no two days look the same.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

 

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

The opportunity

We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out.

You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend.

You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops.

You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week.

What you’ll work on

Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further.

Now

  • Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business.

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes

  • Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure.

  • Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel.

  • Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics.

  • Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team.

Next

  • Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating.

  • Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly.

  • Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users.

  • Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area.

  • Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it.

Later

  • Partner with the General Counsel to produce meaningful Exec-level reporting.

  • Assist with management of large legal projects on GC instruction. Recent examples include M&A diligence coordination, and trademark portfolio work.

  • Support company secretarial administration.

About you

We're looking for a highly organised operator who is energised by building order out of scale-up complexity. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you do need to have run legal operations end-to-end before. The essentials come first below, followed by preferred experience and the traits we care about most.

  • Highly organised with a systems mindset: You keep the plates spinning and notice when one wobbles. You see the workflow behind the task and design for repeatability.

  • Commercial, action-biased, comfortable with ambiguity: You understand what the business needs from legal, get things over the line without waiting to be asked twice, and you're comfortable being the first hire writing the map as you go.

  • Ironclad or equivalent CLM: Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a directly comparable enterprise CLM (for example Juro, LinkSquares, Icertis, Agiloft, Leah). We are deeply embedded in Ironclad and you will own it.

  • Legal operations track record: At least five years' experience running legal operations, contracts operations or a closely adjacent function (compliance operations, legal project management, or legal chief-of-staff), ideally in a scale-up or in-house legal team that is fast paced and where you can demonstrate ownership.

  • End-to-end project delivery: You have owned legal or cross-functional projects on your own steam, including timelines, risks, stakeholders and outcomes.

  • Reporting and data fluency: You can build clean dashboards, work with a KPI framework, and translate metrics into a story someone can act on.

  • Outside counsel spend or panel exposure: Experience setting up spend tracking, panel management or legal project management would be useful, but we're also open to someone with the capability and appetite to build this from scratch.

  • Builder mentality: Experience as a team’s first or only legal-ops hire, or a member of a small team in the early stage of the build-out of a legal ops function, would be a strong advantage.

raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most.

We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders.

You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

Strategic

  • Trusted advisor to your leaders: You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters.

  • Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be.

  • Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve: You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion.

  • Fully embedded in your team: You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully.

  • Catching things early: You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct.

  • Org design: You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage.

  • Talent management: You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming.

  • Learning & development: You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed.

  • Reward: You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible.

  • Performance: You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too.

  • Hands up for the bigger stuff: You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time.

Tactical

  • Employee Relations (ER): Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally.

  • Embedding people products: Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis.

  • Data: Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use.

  • Wellbeing support: 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too.

  • Cultural ambassador: Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made.

  • Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function.

  • Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer.

  • Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call.

  • Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly.

raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The role

As a Strategic Account Manager, you’ll own our largest accounts — the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms. This is a rare combination of Account Management and Enterprise Sales: you’ll be the trusted senior relationship owner for the account and the commercial lead responsible for expanding 9fin into every relevant team, desk, and geography inside it.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Owning the end-to-end relationship and commercial success of a small portfolio of 9fin’s largest most complex accounts, including global banks, top-tier law firms, hedge funds, asset managers and PE sponsors.

  • Acting as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for MDs, Partners, PMs, Heads of Desk and C-suite stakeholders — building deep, multi-threaded relationships across each organisation.

  • Building and executing strategic account plans that map the org, identify white space, and lay out a clear path to materially growing ARR over multi-year horizons.

  • Driving expansion by qualifying and closing new opportunities inside your accounts, new teams, new desks, new asset classes, new geographies — running full enterprise sales cycles alongside your renewal motion.

  • Leading commercial negotiations on multi-year renewals, uplifts and enterprise agreements, partnering with Legal and Finance and on complex procurement and MSA processes.

  • Deeply understanding each client’s workflows in credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed and private credit, and translating those into concrete use cases 9fin can solve.

  • Partnering closely with Product and Engineering to bring the voice of your clients into the roadmap — you are their most credible advocate internally.

  • Representing 9fin externally at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences and roundtables, becoming a recognised name in debt markets.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 7+ years managing and growing strategic enterprise accounts, ideally selling data, SaaS, research or workflow platforms into global banks, buy-side firms, or law firms.

  • Have a proven track record of owning multi-million-dollar accounts and materially expanding them — you can point to specific accounts you’ve grown from $X to $Y and explain exactly how.

  • Combine the depth of a top-tier Account Manager with the commercial edge of a top-tier Enterprise Account Executive — you’re equally comfortable running a strategic QBR with an MD and closing a net-new expansion into a team that’s never used 9fin.

  • Have credibility with senior stakeholders in debt or credit markets, whether from selling to them, working in the industry, or both, and a genuine intellectual interest in the space.

  • Are commercially sharp and operationally rigorous: skilled at navigating complex procurement, legal review, executive alignment, and internal cross-functional work at scale.

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for a Managing Director to own and drive end-to-end Go-To-Market (GTM) performance for one of Aircall’s most strategic countries.
 
This is an end-to-end GTM leadership role with accountability across pipeline generation, sales, and account management, in a high-growth context, at a turning point in Aircall’s trajectory.
 
We are searching for a hands-on, execution-driven leader who combines strategic clarity with operational rigor, builds high-performing teams, and consistently turns ambition into results — while keeping things human, fun, and fast.
 
 
Key Responsibilities

Own and drive end-to-end GTM performance
  • Full ownership of the regional GTM strategy and execution, from pipeline generation to renewals and expansion
  • Accountability for pipeline creation, bookings, ARR growth, retention, and expansion
  • Ensuring tight alignment with Marketing, Partnerships, Product at a regional/ global level

    • Execute ambitious growth targets
  • Translate company-level growth objectives into clear local plans and execution priorities
  • Drive consistent over performance through strong operating cadence, forecasting, and performance management

    • Lead AI-driven growth
  • Make Aircall’s AI Product Suite a central pillar of the local GTM motion
  • Ensure teams are equipped to sell business outcomes and AI-driven value, not just features
  • Identify and unlock new expansion levers through AI (upsell, cross-sell, new segments)

    • Collaborate cross-functionally
  • Partner closely with Product to influence roadmap priorities and bring customer insights to AI innovation
  • Work hand-in-hand with Marketing to drive demand generation, positioning, and regional GTM campaigns
  • Develop and scale Partnerships as a strategic growth lever, including tech, channel, and ecosystem partners

    • Build and inspire high-performing teams
  • Lead, coach, and develop GTM teams across the region
  • Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, and accountability
  • Attract and retain top talent in a highly competitive environment
    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We are strongly committed to hiring a diverse and multicultural team and we encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented backgrounds.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering Team. In this role, you will be a key member of the team managing our analytics and event platform stack.

As part of the Analytics & Data Platform team, you will build features for over 22,000 customers across the globe. Your work will unlock the value of data, empowering our customers to make informed decisions through real-time insights, monitoring, and comprehensive analytical reports.


Your role at Aircall
  • Have key responsibilities within the requirements analysis, scalable & low latency streaming platform solution design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of key modules in order to provide near real-time data solutions for our product
  • Analyze and translate business needs into data model & optimize for big data
  • Identify slow queries and optimize for better performance
  • Write clean scalable code using Scala / python / SQL and test and deploy applications and systems
  • Solve our most challenging data problems, in near real-time, utilizing optimal data architectures, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Be part of an engineering organization delivering high quality, secure, and scalable solutions to Aircall clients
  • Involvement in product and platform performance optimization and live site monitoring
  • Mentor team members through giving and receiving actionable feedback.

    • Our tech. stack:
  • AWS (Kinesis,Kafka, s3, DMS, Glue, EMR, EKS, Redshift, Spectrum), Apache Pinot, Apache Flink and Airflow.
  • A continuous deployment process based on GitLab

  • A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (eg. computer science or mathematics). 
  • 3+ years experience with near real-time analytics
  • 5+ years experience with a modern programming language such as Scala, Python, Go, Typescript
  • Experience of designing complex data processing pipeline
  • Experience of data modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling etc) in AWS redshift
  • Experience of query optimisation

  • Shipping and maintaining code in production

raw.title: Account Manager, SME & Growth
raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the role

As an Airwallex Account Manager, you will build relationships with our existing customers to ensure they are receiving the tools and support needed to achieve their goals. You will be the bridge between the customer and the Airwallex team and will have an in-depth understanding of the customer’s needs and goals and how Airwallex can support them. You will be working in an incredibly fast paced, scaling environment and providing resources across the EMEA business at a senior level, evaluating and scaling Account Management strategy and working closely with Sales, Marketing and Operations Leadership.

Our UK team is growing, we are currently 110+ employees, working in a hybrid work environment with 3 days per week required in our London Office @wells&more - GPE, Fitzrovia.

What you'll do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic accounts, developing account plans, increasing product adoption, deepening relationships, and driving expansion through regular strategic customer engagements.

  • Identify, develop, and close upsell and expansion opportunities, proactively managing opportunities through the sales cycle from identification to close and revenue realisation.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, understanding their business, industry, and goals to help them maximise the value of Airwallex and identify opportunities to support their growth.

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, including bespoke commercial agreements, multi product solutions, and high-value expansion opportunities.

  • Translate customer needs into solutions, with the ability to understand technical requirements and work across multiple products to develop compelling, commercially viable solutions.

  • Operate with ownership and agility, demonstrating the ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.

  • Demonstrate a strong track record of performance and a passion for technology, consistently achieving or exceeding KPIs and revenue targets while maintaining the curiosity to understand and articulate the value of an evolving technology landscape.

What you bring

  • 2+ years of experience in account management or sales, ideally selling a technical product, with a proven track record of top performance.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to manage complex sales cycles, understand customer strategies and pain points, and articulate compelling value propositions. Experience with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC is preferred.

  • Proven track record of exceeding targets, with demonstrated success in high target, high pace environments and consistently delivering against commercial KPIs and revenue goals.

We operate at the intersection of strategy, regulation, product, and execution, working closely with leaders across Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Finance, and Operations. The team combines strategic thinking with an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach to building and scaling our international presence.

What you'll do

As Director, International Expansion, you will lead Airwallex's expansion into new markets globally, shaping where and how we grow and building the regulatory, product, and operational foundations to succeed.

You will own a portfolio of market-entry initiatives end to end, from evaluating opportunities and defining entry strategies through licensing, product localisation, operational readiness, and commercial launch.

Reporting to the CEO's Chief of Staff, you will lead a lean team and work directly with senior executives to influence strategic decisions, mobilise cross-functional teams, and overcome the complex challenges of entering new markets.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who combines strategic judgment, an entrepreneurial mindset, and the ability to translate ambitious plans into tangible outcomes. You will build and lead the expansion function while remaining directly involved in the most strategically important and complex market-entry initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Lead global expansion strategy: Own the strategy and execution of Airwallex's expansion into new markets globally. Evaluate and prioritise market opportunities, define entry strategies, and recommend where and how Airwallex should invest to establish and scale its presence.

Take accountability for delivering market entries and navigating the strategic and execution challenges along the way.

  • Define regulatory and operating models: Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Finance to determine the optimal licensing, legal entity, and operating structures for each market. Translate regulatory requirements into practical, scalable business models that support Airwallex's long-term ambitions.

  • Drive executive alignment and investment decisions: Work directly with the CEO's Chief of Staff and senior executives to shape expansion priorities, resolve critical trade-offs, secure resources, and drive timely decisions. Present clear recommendations on market opportunities, regulatory strategy, investment requirements, and launch readiness.

  • Build external relationships: Partner with local regulators, financial institutions, payment networks, advisers, and other strategic stakeholders to support regulatory approvals, establish local capabilities, and unlock new market opportunities.

  • Drive broader CEO Office priorities: Support or lead high-impact strategic initiatives beyond international expansion, working across the business to solve complex problems, shape company-level decisions, and drive execution on critical priorities.

  • Intellectually curious, resilient, and hungry to win. You thrive on solving difficult problems, challenge conventional thinking, learn quickly, and have the drive and persistence to turn ambitious goals into results.

  • Strong strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate complex trade-offs, and translate big-picture thinking into practical execution.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and complex cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and drive outcomes in fast-paced environments.

As Customer Success Team Lead, you’ll lead a team of approximately five Customer Success Executives. Together, you’ll help qualified SME prospects move through their onboarding journey, converting leads into open, funded and actively used Allica business current accounts.

This is a highly collaborative role. You’ll work closely with Relationship Management, Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, Customer Due Diligence and Operations to improve the onboarding experience, remove friction and create better outcomes for customers.

  • Understanding our onboarding process and requirements and supporting customers and prospects through this process to open current accounts and deliver a great customer experience.

  • Gaining feedback from customers and prospects on potential future features they need and want from their bank and bank account and feeding these into the Product teams.

  • You will have managed and led a team either in person or remotely to successfully achieve KPIs relating to customer and colleague experience.

raw.title: Head of Solution Consulting R&D / Field CSO
raw.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW

R&D leaders trust people who have done the science. More than half of the world's top 50 biopharma companies already use Benchling, and many of the most important are in Europe. Our ambition is 10x faster science, from idea to first dose. With Science Foundries, launched at Benchtalk 2026, agents and scientists run entire R&D workflows together, so a three-person team can have the productive capacity of thirty.

In a senior R&D role, you can change how one organisation does science. As our Field CSO, you'll take one question to R&D organisations across EMEA: how do we get from idea to first dose 10x faster?

ROLE OVERVIEW

You'll lead our EMEA R&D Solution Consulting organisation: a team of 12, with two first-line leaders covering our Enterprise and Strategic segments, plus occasional support for APAC deals. You'll be the scientific counterpart to our General Manager, EMEA, and work alongside our Field CTO. They lead on IT, data science and architecture; you lead on the scientists and how their work changes.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Be the scientific voice in the room. Brief the GM and account teams before key meetings, then join them as a peer to the CSOs and Heads of R&D across the table. Act as senior sponsor on our largest EMEA opportunities, and use account-team introductions to open new R&D relationships.

  • Lead the 10x conversation. Turn Benchling's vision, from AI agents to Science Foundries, into a credible plan R&D leaders can act on, including how their scientists move onto Benchling and what changes in the lab.

  • Lead and develop two first-line leaders and their team of 10. Provide in-region leadership continuity, set the scientific bar for every customer engagement, and build a succession plan as the team grows.

  • Shape EMEA strategy and the roadmap. Decide with sales leadership where to focus the team's expertise, and bring patterns from the field back to Product, Marketing and global Solution Consulting.

HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS

This is a commercial role with a scientific core. We'll look at EMEA revenue growth and influenced pipeline, technical win rate, forecast accuracy on the technical side of deals, regional ownership of our largest R&D relationships, and the strength of your leadership bench.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Substantial hands-on R&D experience in biotech or pharma, with a PhD or equivalent scientific depth. You've run experiments, led programmes and know how large R&D organisations make decisions and adopt change.

  • A record of driving change, from adopting new technologies to rethinking how your teams work, and clear views on how AI will change R&D.

  • Experience leading through other managers, and executive presence with VPs, Heads of R&D and C-level leaders.

  • Commercial ambition and a growth mindset. We'll teach you how software is sold. We can't teach how a large R&D organisation works from the inside, and that's what you bring.

  • Readiness for a field role: frequent on-site time with the largest pharma and biotech companies across EMEA, plus US travel three to four times a year for team offsites and our global sales kickoff.

  • Fluency in English; German or French is a plus.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with Benchling or a comparable R&D platform (ELN, LIMS or R&D data platform), including leading its evaluation or rollout

  • Customer-facing scientific, internal consulting, or CRO/CDMO programme leadership roles

  • Presales or solution consulting experience

 

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer / BI Analyst to bridge the gap between data engineering and business insight. You’ll take ownership of transforming raw data into trusted, well modelled datasets and deliver impactful reporting that drives decision making across the business. This role combines strong technical data modelling skills with stakeholder-facing analytics and BI development.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery)

  • Create and maintain dashboards and explores in Looker, enabling self-serve analytics

  • Translate business requirements into clear data models, metrics, and visualisations

  • Define and maintain core business metrics and data definitions in partnership with stakeholders and the wider analytics team

  • Implement data quality checks, testing, and documentation within dbt

  • Partner with stakeholders across all parts of the business including commercial, product, marketing, finance, and operations

  • Optimise query performance and manage cost efficiency in BigQuery

  • Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics engineering across the wider analytics team

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience in analytics engineering, BI or data analytics roles

  • Strong SQL skills (expert level, performance tuning experience preferred)

  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms and distributed data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake)

  • Proven experience with dbt (modelling, testing, documentation)

  • Experience building dashboards in Looker (LookML is a strong plus)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling concepts (star schema, dimensional modelling)

  • Experience working with large-scale datasets

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

    • Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

Account Manager

About Us

ClaimSorted helps insurers outsource claims end to end – a service called Third-Party Administration (TPA), a ~$200B industry. We combine a strong in-house claims team with our AI-enabled platform to deliver up to 3× faster claims, better service, and better economics for insurers.

Backed by Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo, we’ve raised $15M+ and already manage claims for over $100M in insurance premium across 30+ MGAs, including more than five publicly traded companies. Our goal: scale to $1B and become the most valuable TPA in the market.

The Role

You will own the full customer relationship: onboarding, go-live, retention, renewals, expansion, and work directly with the CEO as the customer’s internal quarterback at ClaimSorted.

  • Lead onboarding and delivery: build the plan, drive the timeline, and ensure a clean go-live

  • Coordinate Ops, Claims, and Product to unblock issues fast and keep clients confident

  • Run the account rhythm: success plans, SLAs, escalation paths, and exec updates

  • Spot risk early, de-escalate issues, and earn renewals and references

  • Find and close expansion opportunities (new programs, regions, lines, volume)

  • Turn what works into repeatable playbooks, templates, and routines

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We’re a high-intensity team because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

Qualifications

We care more about hunger and grit than years on a CV. You might be a management consultant who’s seen insurance pain points firsthand, or a top-performing Account Manager ready for something bigger.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to London

  • Work authorisation in the UK without need of sponsorship

  • Commercially minded with the ability to map value and close expansions

  • Strong relationship builder who earns trust across stakeholders and stays calm under pressure

  • 2+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, sales, or insurance/InsurTech(a plus)

Our Values

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’

  • Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

  • Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

  • Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member

  • Medical insurance

  • Pension contributions (UK)

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

BUILDING A MORE RESILIENT WORLD

ABOUT CLAIMSORTED

At ClaimSorted, we’re building a more resilient world - one where people and businesses have the confidence to pursue bigger opportunities. We’re doing this by transforming how insurance delivers on its most important promise: helping people and businesses recover when things go wrong.

The world’s largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies work with us to handle claims and manage risk more efficiently, so they - and the people they protect - can move forward with confidence.

Backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo, we grew 10x in the past year - and we’re just getting started.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our founding GTM team and create a steady pipeline of qualified leads for our Strategic Account Executives (SAEs). You’ll be the first conversation most of our future customers have with ClaimSorted, finding the right people at the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies in the world and giving them a reason to listen.

You’ll be measured on two things:

  • Volume: a high level of prospecting across email, LinkedIn, phone and other channels

  • Conversion: a high prospect-to-qualified-meeting rate, so every meeting you hand to an SAE is worth their time

What you’ll do:

  • Research accounts, identify the right stakeholders, and build targeted lead lists at the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies

  • Run high-volume outbound across email, LinkedIn, phone and whatever else cuts through with people who get pitched constantly

  • Treat outreach as a structured process, using AI tools to research, personalize and scale your prospecting without losing quality

  • Qualify relentlessly, so every meeting you book is a real opportunity and not noise

  • Own top-of-funnel end to end, from first touch to a booked, qualified meeting handed to an SAE

  • Refine our outbound messaging as you go, feeding what you learn from hundreds of conversations back into how we message and target

  • Work directly with Claims and Product, so what you hear from prospects shapes how we position what we build next

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, in-office role in our London office. We’re a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

WHO YOU ARE

You have at least a year in a communications-heavy role, ideally in sales or something adjacent (SDR/BDR, recruiting, customer success, account management or similar), and you’re ready to step up into a high-growth enterprise sales environment.

  • Great written and spoken communicator: you can get a stranger to reply to a cold email or pick up the phone, and you keep sharpening your messaging when the data says it isn’t landing

  • A sharp researcher: you can quickly work out who the relevant people are at a large organization and what would make them care

  • AI-fluent: you use AI tools to do better prospecting, and you treat outreach as a structured, repeatable process rather than ad hoc effort

  • Built for volume: you stay sharp and motivated through a lot of “no” on the way to “yes”

  • Coachable and fast-learning: you take feedback on your outreach and improve week over week, not quarter over quarter

  • Organized and process-driven: you keep a high-volume pipeline clean so nothing falls through the cracks

  • Ambitious: you want this to be the start of a sales career, not a one-year stop

OUR VALUES

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

  • Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’

  • Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Generous, transparent equity participation

  • 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • 30 days of remote work annually

  • Private medical insurance

  • Pension contributions

  • Company offsites

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

raw.title: Founding Strategy & Operations Lead - London
raw.description:
Building a More Resilient World

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.

The Role

Handling claims at scale requires simultaneous operational and product expertise. As our Founding Strategy & Operations Lead, you'll build the operational framework that lets ClaimSorted scale, and make sure every Partner we bring on is properly embedded and well served as we grow. You'll own the operational journey that takes a new Partner from signed contract to live claims, coordinate the people across the company to make that happen, and work with our Product team to ensure our technology works from day one. As part of this role you will:

  • Build a clear, structured onboarding process that takes Partners from Sales through set-up and into Account Management, accounting for differences by region, line of business and program.

  • Own operational coordination during onboarding, so everyone involved knows who is responsible for what.

  • Simplify how Partners' systems integrate with ours, and lead the set-up and implementation of our technology-enabled capabilities, such as FNOL, policy analysis and system automations.

  • Take what you learn from Partners back to the Product team, so every onboarding is faster than the last.

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We're a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in operations, implementation or consulting at a high-growth startup, tech firm or consultancy

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with external Partners or clients, in a role where you owned the relationship

  • A track record of implementing systems and processes across multiple regions

  • Experience leading system integrations or technology rollouts for external clients

  • The ability to lead without authority, coordinating peers across Sales, Claims, Product and Account Management to get things done

  • Expertise turning chaos into process, and ensuring those processes survive as the team grows

  • Strong written and spoken communication with Partners and with internal teams

  • Insurance or claims experience is a plus, but not required

Our Values

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimise for momentum.

  • Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'

  • Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Generous, transparent equity participation

  • 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • 30 days of remote work annually

  • Private medical insurance

  • Pension contributions

  • Company offsites

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

raw.description:
About ClaimSorted

At ClaimSorted, we’re building a more resilient world - one where people and businesses have the confidence to pursue bigger opportunities. We’re doing this by transforming how insurance delivers on its most important promise: helping people and businesses recover when things go wrong.

The world’s largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies work with us to handle claims and manage risk more efficiently, so they - and the people they protect - can move forward with confidence.

Backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo, we grew 10x in the past year - and we’re just getting started.


The Role

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to join our founding GTM team and drive our next wave of growth, win new logos, and expand deals. You’ll own the full sales cycle, working with C-level executives at multibillion-dollar companies to transform how their businesses operate.

Success in this role goes well beyond closing deals. You’ll need to deeply understand each customer’s business, challenge their thinking, and work with them to build tailored solutions that fundamentally change how they work.

  • Create, drive, and close high-stakes deals with the largest insurance companies in the world - the kind of deals where a single signature changes how a multi-billion-dollar insurer handles every claim it processes

  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers - learning their needs and demonstrating how our products can solve real problems

  • Own your pipeline end-to-end, from first conversation to signed contract - running sharp, data-driven sales cycles that lead with insight and never lose urgency

  • Help shape our GTM playbook - feed what you learn in the field back into how we grow and sell, so the infrastructure we build scales because it's grounded in what actually works, not theory

  • Get real product influence - work directly with Claims and Product, not into a backlog that disappears, but as a genuine hand in what we build next. At this stage, what you hear from customers changes the roadmap

  • Build long-term customer relationships - support post-sale success in partnership with our deployment and support teams

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, in-office role in our London HQ. We're a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

 

Who You Are

We care more about hunger and grit than years on a resumes. You might be a management consultant who's seen insurance's pain points firsthand, or a top-performing full-cycle sales rep ready for something bigger.

  • Full-cycle sales experience — you own everything from first conversation to signed contract, not just closing what someone else built

  • Strong discovery and qualification skills — MEDDICC, BANT, or your own version

  • Comfortable selling into large, complex organizations with multiple decision-makers and a longer, higher-stakes buying process

  • A relationship builder - you need to get customers’ trust quickly and approach sales with empathy and curiosity

  • Based in, or ready to relocate to, New York City

  • Able to work in the US without visa sponsorship

  • High tempo, sharp focus, and resilience — you keep moving when a deal falls through

  • You'd rather build the sales org than join one that's already built

Our Values

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

  • Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'

  • Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Generous, transparent equity participation

  • Skilled Worker visa sponsorship

  • 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • 30 days of remote work annually

  • Private medical insurance

  • Pension contributions in line with UK auto-enrolment requirements

raw.description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

We are looking for a senior creative leader to define the next chapter of Contentsquare’s brand and lead the evolution of our global Studio.

You will set the creative vision for how Contentsquare shows up in the world. Your mission is to elevate our brand, making it more distinctive, modern, and recognizable, and ensuring our creative expression positions us as a leader in our industry.

You will drive the creative evolution of our brand across every touchpoint, from campaigns and product launches to web, events, motion, and executive storytelling. You'll push creative boundaries, champion bold ideas, and set an exceptional standard for quality and differentiation.

A key part of the role is translating complex technology, data, and AI innovation into simple, compelling creative experiences. You'll partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, and GTM teams to understand what makes our platform unique and bring that story to life.

You'll also lead and transform our global Studio, developing a high-performing team of designers, creative leads, and agency partners. You'll evolve our brand system and embrace AI, automation, and self-service to scale production, freeing the team to focus on creativity, craft, and high-impact work.

Your mission: build a category-defining brand and a world-class, AI-enabled creative organization to bring it to life.


What you’ll own

Brand creative direction

  • Set the creative vision for Contentsquare and hold an exceptional standard across launches, campaigns, brand, web, events, and executive storytelling.

  • Champion bold ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and push the team beyond safe, predictable creative work.

  • Stay ahead of what the best brands are doing, in SaaS, AI, technology, and beyond, to create work that is unmistakably ours.

    • The team 

    • Lead, develop, and retain exceptional designers and team leads, building a high-performing culture of craft, bold thinking, ownership, and accountability. Empower the team to take creative risks and make strong decisions independently.

    • Build and manage a network of world-class agencies and specialist partners, bringing fresh perspectives and expertise. Own agency selection, creative direction, budgets, and performance, ensuring exceptional quality and the flexibility to scale during peak demand.

      • The platform and product story

      • Build a deep understanding of our platform, AI capabilities, and technology, keeping the Studio closely connected to our product and customers.

      • Partner early with Product and Product Marketing to turn complex technology into simple, compelling, and memorable creative experiences.

      • Bring our product story to life through distinctive design, motion, video, and storytelling across every relevant touchpoint.

        • The Brand System

        • Evolve our visual identity into a distinctive, recognizable, and scalable brand system that reflects our ambition as an AI leader.

        • Build reusable frameworks, templates, and self-service tools that help teams create effectively without compromising quality.

        • Know when to scale through the system and when an idea deserves something entirely new.

          • AI in the studio

          • Lead how the Studio uses AI across design, copy, production, and creative operations.

          • Use AI to absorb repetitive work and production volume, expanding creative capabilities and giving the team more time for ideas, craft, and innovation.

          • Help the team adopt new tools and workflows confidently, without compromising creative quality or brand standards.

            • How the creative studio runs

            • Own the Studio operating model, including priorities, resourcing, project management, creative reviews, and delivery across internal teams and external partners.

            • Build a fast, effective, and scalable operation that anticipates demand, manages production peaks, and removes unnecessary complexity.

            • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, Content, Web, Comms, and GTM teams, engaging early enough to shape the work rather than simply receive briefs.


What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years across design, brand, creative, or Studio leadership, including 5+ years leading teams in SaaS or technology.

  • Experience managing managers/team leads and operating in complex, global organizations.

  • Exceptional portfolio with a high creative bar across brand, digital, campaigns, and product storytelling.

  • Strong ability to turn complex technology and AI into simple, compelling creative narratives.

  • Deep understanding of SaaS/tech; AI or AI-native experience is a strong plus.

  • Proven experience evolving brand/design systems and scaling quality through templates and self-service.

  • Hands-on experience transforming creative teams with AI across workflows, automation, production, and enablement.

  • Strong command of Creative Operations, resourcing, agencies, and end-to-end Studio workflows.

  • Strong benchmarking instincts and a clear point of view on differentiation and creative excellence.
  • Excellent executive communication and cross-functional partnership skills.

    • You’ll Thrive in This Role If You

    • Have exceptional creative taste and a strong point of view on what our brand could become.

    • Understand the product deeply enough to find the creative idea within it, rather than waiting for a brief to define it.

    • Turn complex technology, data, and AI into simple, human, and memorable creative experiences.

    • Know what the best brands are doing, both in our category and far beyond it, and are more interested in what nobody has done yet.

    • Move confidently between setting creative vision, challenging the details, shaping product storytelling, and leading a high-performing team.

    • See AI as a way to take more creative risks, not fewer. Let it handle the volume so your team can focus on the work only people can do.

    • Build simple systems that keep creative teams fast, collaborative, and effective, while knowing which work deserves something entirely original.

    • Challenge work that's merely good enough, inspiring teams and agency partners to push for exceptional.

    • Balance bold creative ambition with a strong understanding of customer impact and business outcomes.


    What Success Looks Like

    Within your first year, we would expect to see:

    • A visibly higher and more consistent creative bar across the company.

    • A distinctive creative language for our platform, products, and AI capabilities that makes complex technology easier to understand and more exciting to experience.

    • A Studio that is deeply connected to Product and Product Marketing and engaged earlier in the storytelling process.

    • Strong differentiation from competitors across our visual identity, campaigns, product launches, and customer-facing experiences.

    • A strong, scalable brand and design system.

    • A clear Studio operating model with stronger prioritization, ownership, and delivery.

    • Meaningful adoption of AI across creative workflows, resulting in faster execution, better output, and expanded team capacity.

    • More teams able to self-serve effectively through high-quality templates, systems, and guidelines.

    • Strong leadership across the Studio, with team leads operating with greater autonomy and accountability.

    • Better balance between internal resources, agencies, automation, and self-service.

    • A Studio viewed by the business not as a production function, but as a strategic partner in how we bring our product and technology to the world.

    Why you should join Contentsquare
    We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.
     
    Here are a few we want to highlight:
    - Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
    - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
    - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
    - Lifestyle allowance
    - A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
    - Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success
    - We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts
    - And more benefits tailored to each country
     
    Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
     
    Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here. 
     
    Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.
     
    Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Principal Software Engineer
raw.description:
You’ll be a Technical Leader, unblock the engineering team by resolving complex technical impasses, standardising engineering practices, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

You'll still be a highly hands-on engineer, responsible for rapidly prototyping, shipping MVPs, and turning product ideas into polished user experiences. You’ll work across the stack, collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering teams while operating with a high degree of independence.

 

What you'll do

 

  • Build and ship new product features end-to-end

  • Lead rapid prototyping and MVP development

  • Develop modern frontend applications using TypeScript, Vue 3 Composition API, and Tailwind

  • Contribute to backend services using Node, Bun, Koa, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and AWS

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to shape product direction

  • Improve performance, reliability, and developer experience across the platfor

  • Support on hiring, performance and technical roadmaps.

 

What you'll need

 

  • Extensive experience building modern frontend applications with TypeScript and Vue3

  • Solid backend experience with Node-based services and relational databases

  • Experience working with PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS, and REST APIs

  • Comfortable moving quickly, making pragmatic decisions, and shipping iteratively

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Able to work independently in a hybrid environment

  • Ideally have been in early stage start-ups going through growth and technical challenges

 

What you'll get

  • Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off

  • Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team.

  • A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme.

  • Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover.

  • More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme.

  • Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.


About Cytix

  • Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

  • That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

    We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

     

    Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

     

    Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

     

    See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

     

    Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

     

    Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

    Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

Compensation: £100K – £120K • Equity
