raw.description:
About Infinite Lambda

Infinite Lambda is a global data and AI consultancy on a mission to make innovation accessible. We help organisations build the data foundations and business context they need for enterprise AI to actually work: from modern data platforms to agentic enablement and our software solution, Flowline.

We are a Certified B Corporation, with 7 legal entities around the world, and are proud to nurture a workplace where decent human beings can do their best work. Curiosity is our default setting, autonomy is non-negotiable, and impact is the whole point.

The role

As our Fractional Legal Counsel, you will be the senior legal partner to our COO, Exec team, and Board. In a fractional capacity, you will be part of the team, close to the people who win and deliver the work, and trusted to make the calls that keep us keep moving.

We need someone who can start adding value from their first week. You will handle our most important contracts and legal questions across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, and set up the templates, playbooks, and processes that let the business handle routine matters with confidence when you are not there.

Being qualified in both England & Wales and the US means you can cover our two largest legal systems directly and coordinate local counsel everywhere else.

You will report to the COO and work closely with our CFO and General Managers, as many of our legal questions (commercial terms, liability, entity structure and governance) sit at the intersection of legal, finance, and operations. As the business grows, you will also help us decide what our long-term legal function should look like.

What you will own

This role spans four pillars. As the role is fractional, focus matters a lot: you will prioritise what only a senior lawyer can do, bring in external support where it makes sense, and build the tools that let the business help itself.

1. Commercial contracting & client advice

  • Reviewing and negotiating our priority client agreements: MSAs, SOWs and framework agreements under English and US law

  • Drafting key partner, vendor, and supplier agreements

  • Advising clients and internal teams on cross-border matters across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC

  • Setting clear positions on liability, IP ownership, and data terms, so deals keep moving

2. Governance, risk & compliance

  • Flagging the legal risks that matter most and recommending priorities to the COO and Exec team;

  • Oversight of corporate governance and entity matters across our 7 legal entities, working with local advisers;

  • Supporting the Exec team and board matters when legal input is needed;

  • Keeping our compliance posture current, including anti-bribery, sanctions, and export controls.

3. Data, AI & intellectual property

  • Data protection and privacy across the UK, EU and US, including DPAs and international transfers;

  • Guidance on AI regulation, including the EU AI Act, as it applies to our services;

  • Protecting our intellectual property, including our flagship product, Flowline.

4. Building the legal foundations

  • Contract templates, negotiation playbooks and approval rules for routine matters;

  • A simple intake and tracking process so everyone knows what is in progress;

  • Selecting and managing external counsel for specialist or local-law work, within budget;

  • Helping shape the scope of a future full-time legal hire if and when we need one.

Who you are

We are not looking for a particular CV but for a particular kind of lawyer, namely senior, commercial, honest, and genuinely interested in the work our teams do.

Experience that matters

  • Qualified as a solicitor in England & Wales and the US (preferrably), with both qualifications current and in good standing;

  • 7+ years' PQE, with training at a leading law firm and in-house experience, ideally in technology, data, AI or professional services;

  • A track record of working fractionally, as an interim, or as a consultant lawyer, and of making an impact quickly;

  • Strong commercial contracting experience, especially services, technology and SaaS agreements;

  • Experience advising on cross-border matters across the UK, EU, and US, with exposure to APAC a plus;

  • Working knowledge of data protection, IP, and emerging AI regulation;

  • Experience setting up legal processes or being a company's first legal adviser;

  • Your own professional indemnity insurance, or cover through your platform or consultancy.

Your approach

  • You prioritise ruthlessly and are clear about what can wait;

  • You give clear answers and a recommendation, not a list of risks;

  • You build trust with clients, colleagues and leadership because you are straight with them;

  • You leave things better documented than you found them, so the business is never stuck waiting for you;

  • You bring rigour without bureaucracy. Life is too short for red tape;

  • You are aligned with our company values. This matters to us.

How the engagement works

  • 10 days a month with flexibility around specific working hours and with reasonable availability for urgent matters outside of those;

  • A shared request channel and a simple tracker so priorities are visible to everyone;

  • A regular check-in with the COO to review workload, priorities and whether the agreed working days still fit;

  • Additional days agreed in advance, at the same day rate.

Why work with us

  • Being your true self: show up as you are. We work with people for character, not conformity;

  • Practising innovation: front-row seat to the rapid evolution of data and AI, and the legal questions that come with it;

  • Living autonomously: remote-first, with flexibility on how you structure your days;

  • Real influence: a senior voice in a growing global business, working directly with the COO and Exec team.

We are a Certified B Corporation. That means we measure ourselves not just by what we deliver, but by how we deliver it because of our people, our clients, our communities, and the environment.

Our Legal Counsel will help make sure that commitment is reflected in how we contract and govern ourselves.

The practicalities

  • Engagement: Fractional, initial term of 12 months with the option to extend;

  • Contract: Consultancy agreement, directly, through your own company, or through a fractional legal platform; IR35 status assessed before contracting;

  • Location: Remote-first / UK / US;

  • Reports to: COO;

  • Key partnerships: CEO, CTO, CFO, and other Exec team members; General Managers, Sales and Partnership leads, Head of People / HR;

  • Compensation: competitive day rate.

Our hiring process

  1. Application review

  2. Screening conversation with our Talent Acquisition team

  3. Interview with the COO and CTO/CEO

  4. Technical interview with one of our legal advisors

▶ ▶ Submit your CV in English in PDF, with your day rate, availability, and preferred engagement route.

▶ ▶ Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

▶ ▶ We will verify your qualifications on the SRA register and the relevant US state bar register before your first interview.

▶ ▶ To ensure legislative compliance, applicants may be asked to provide up-to-date proof of a clean criminal record, such as a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check (UK) or a country-specific equivalent. This is the final step in the process and will only be requested once terms are agreed.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Introducer Tech builds the systems that partners in Germany use to refer businesses to iwoca. The aim is to get new partners integrated quickly and to make applying simple for their customers. The team also looks after how partners earn commission.

Its work covers three main areas:

  • The Lending API. Developing the versioned API and the webhooks that keep partners up to date on their customers.

  • The Introducer Portal. Building the web app that German brokers log in to, to submit applications and upload documents.

  • The sign-up journey. Improving how businesses apply and how well they convert, after a partner referral.

The team is growing to have two product managers, who each focus on either the broker or the partner flow, and three engineers across the backend and frontend, including this hire.

The team currently works in sprints, with three stand-ups a week and planning every two weeks. However, there is room to adapt how it works as it grows.

The role

You'll be the senior engineer behind iwoca's broker and partner channels in Germany, from the tools partners integrate with to the internal systems that broker account managers use.

Ownership and autonomy

  • Own the Lending API in Germany end to end, deciding what to build, when to release a new version, when to retire an old one, and what iwoca can promise partners.

  • Own the developer portal and every tool partners use to integrate, from documentation that their developers and coding agents can build from to self-serve testing that needs no help from iwoca.

Impact

  • Ship the features that make partners choose iwoca, starting with pre-qualification, which shows a customer what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Make integration quick and simple, so a partner can go live with few questions and little hand-holding.

  • Automate parts of the broker funnel and the internal CRM that broker account managers use, cutting friction and the lag between a decision and the action that follows, and building agents wherever they help.

Growth trajectory

  • Set the team's technical direction and shape the product and technical roadmap alongside the product manager.

  • Align designs with the UK engineers who share the API, so German requirements shape the design from the start.

  • As well as being hands on, you’ll develop your mentoring and coaching skills. You’ll help lead the team as the most senior engineer.

You'll work with the commercial colleagues who bring in new partners, and join the team's weekly support rotation.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built production backend systems in Python – ideally with Django, though FastAPI or Flask count too. You've used PostgreSQL or another relational database in production, and kept it fast and maintainable.

  • API design. You've built and evolved APIs that other teams or companies depend on, and made the decisions on structure, versioning, and change.

  • Ownership. You've taken work from a commercial problem through to production – scoping the solution, making the trade-offs, and iterating based on how people use it.

  • Mentoring. You've helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Partner onboarding. You've helped external developers integrate with an API – through documentation, test environments, or working with them directly.

  • Full-stack. You've contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • CI/CD. You've set up or maintained the pipelines that test and release a production service.

  • Measurement. You've used data, metrics, or A/B tests to check whether a change had the effect you intended.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

raw.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it.

You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer, using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.

You'll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build a better outbound engine: improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, sequencing and measurement so the team consistently reaches the right companies at the right time

  • Make the GTM team more productive: automate repetitive work across account research, meeting preparation, follow-ups, CRM hygiene and handoffs so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

  • Run the revenue operating infrastructure: own the systems behind pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation, renewals and expansion

  • Set the rules of engagement: own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person

  • Improve how revenue work moves through Kernel: build reliable routing, attribution, account assignment and cross-functional handoffs, resolve edge cases and make performance visible

  • Be Kernel's own internal customer: deploy Kernel on our CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and workflows, and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience: you have worked in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM Engineering at a high-growth Series B-E SaaS company and owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behavior

  • Strong GTM building ability: you have built useful systems with Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools, and you know how to move from a rough idea to a reliable workflow that people adopt

  • Commercial judgment: you understand how accounts become meetings, meetings become pipeline, pipeline is qualified and forecast, and won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention

  • Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented information into trustworthy workflows, measure what is working and create feedback loops that improve performance over time

  • Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC

  • Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning

  • Familiarity with Gong, sales engagement platforms and modern enrichment or intent tooling

  • Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself

  • Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress

  • See GTM Engineering primarily as CRM administration or ticket fulfillment rather than a revenue-generating function

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function

  • Prefer a predictable, low-intensity environment

  • Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup. We are in the office together 4-5 days a week and the pace is high

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £70,000-£90,000 + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 monthly office dinner allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to build the systems that power an AI-native revenue engine

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

❤️ Team

Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations

Amin Shafi, BizOps Associate

Dave Bentham, Head of Sales

🎫 Visas & Relocation

Not offered for this role.

Interview Process

  • Stage 1: Screening: Intro call

  • Stage 2: Technical: In-person case interview

  • Stage 3: Coffee chat: In-person discussion with members of our GTM team

  • Final stage: Values: Interview with founders for culture and values alignment

If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer.

raw.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

As a Junior Data Quality Analyst, you will play a crucial role in safeguarding the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of Kpler’s global commodity market data, with a primary focus on Oil Market Data. Working cross-functionally across business units, you will monitor data health metrics, identify system anomalies, and build actionable dashboards that empower decision-makers. In this role, you will also help pioneer internal workflow automation by experimenting with modern AI-driven tools to streamline data validation and analysis

Key Responsibilities
  • Monitor and safeguard data integrity: Track data quality KPIs across multiple systems to detect inconsistencies, anomalies, and gaps, escalating critical issues to protect global commodity data reliability.
  • Build intuitive visual analytics: Design, deploy, and maintain dynamic BI dashboards and reports to present clear data health insights to key stakeholders.
  • Perform exploratory analysis: Utilize SQL and BI software to investigate datasets, discover underlying patterns, and resolve complex data quality challenges.
  • Drive process automation & AI integration: Streamline data validation workflows by leveraging automation tools, prompt engineering, and modern AI techniques.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner closely with Data Operations, Business Unit Engineers, Data Engineers, and BI teams to align data quality standards with business needs.
  • Conduct root-cause investigations: Address ad-hoc stakeholder inquiries and deliver swift, accurate data analysis to support operational decision-making

    • Experience & Background
  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience in a data-focused role or internship (e.g., Data Analysis, BI, or Data Science).
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a quantitative field such as Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Solid foundational SQL skills with the ability to query, filter, aggregate, and join complex tables efficiently.
  • Practical familiarity with Python, GitHub, and spreadsheet tools (Excel or Google Sheets) for data manipulation and profiling.
  • Working experience with modern BI visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and a desire to take end-to-end ownership of data accuracy.

    • Nice-to-haves:

  • Exposure to or strong interest in energy, commodities, or Oil & Gas markets.
  • Active interest in AI tools and best practices, with a focus on improving documentation, streamlining workflows, and enhancing quality assurance processes.

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

  • Gather and communicate structured customer feedback to the AI Product team, identifying product gaps, technical blockers, integration challenges and opportunities to influence the product roadmap.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product and Marketing teams to resolve technical challenges, develop customer-facing content and support AI product education across the business.
  • Contribute to pipeline development through account and stakeholder mapping, opportunity qualification, industry events and customer engagement.

  • Strong API knowledge, including REST, authentication methods and rate limits, with the ability to read and troubleshoot technical documentation.
  • Comfortable using Python or notebooks to prototype demonstrations and explore technical use cases.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical audiences and senior business stakeholders.

raw.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

As a Refined Products Inventory Analyst, you will play a central role in powering Kpler's storage intelligence and driving the expansion of our brand-new inventory product from regional hubs to global coverage. Operating at the intersection of data operations, satellite imagery validation, and oil market analysis, you will ensure the precision, completeness, and strategic value of our global refined products dataset. By mapping terminal infrastructure and translating complex data into actionable market intelligence, you will directly empower commodity traders and market participants to navigate evolving energy dynamics with confidence.

Key Responsibilities
  • Map and classify terminal infrastructure: Identify, map, and classify refined product storage assets, blending units, and interconnection networks by product category and operational function.
  • Validate satellite imagery and aerial data: Utilize satellite and thermal imagery to verify storage tank structures, estimate fill capacities, and detect operational shifts or anomalies across key energy hubs.
  • Optimize data workflows: Design and streamline scalable procedures for terminal onboarding, quality assurance, and automated processing in collaboration with engineering and data operations teams.
  • Integrate market and refinery context: Apply operational knowledge of refinery storage, blending processes, and transport dynamics (pipeline, barge, truck, ship) to maintain high data integrity during market disruptions or maintenance events.
  • Support regional and global expansion: Lead the data rollout from current European and North American hubs to global coverage, establishing robust methodologies for new geographical regions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally and support commercial teams: Partner with internal research, commercial, and product teams to share methodology, gather client feedback, and support sales enablement.
  • Lead responses to ad-hoc client requests with rapid, well-structured analysis: Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to address client data needs and feed insights back into internal systems. 

    • Experience & Background

    What you'll need (Must-haves):

  • 5+ years of experience in inventory intelligence, terminal logistics, or oil market data analytics and operations.
  • Strong technical comfort with data handling tools such as Excel, SQL, or Python to process and audit complex datasets.
  • Proven ability to think autonomously, build operational workflows from scratch, and resolve granular data issues in a remote work environment.

    • Nice-to-haves:

  • In-depth understanding of refined products storage infrastructure (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, fuel oil), including tank functions, blending operations, and dispatch practices.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally across product, engineering, and commercial teams within a commodity or market data environment.
  • Demonstrated capability in working with satellite, aerial, or thermal imagery to validate asset structures and extract operational intelligence.

raw.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
raw.description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

We do not partner with search firms.

 

About

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build and improve the products and systems behind Lokalise. You'll work closely with Product, Design, other engineers, and stakeholders to identify and solve meaningful customer problems, improve existing experiences, and shape what we build next.

Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, uncover their pains and needs, define their own goals, and choose how to solve the problems that matter most. We're hiring across multiple domains, so you'll own a real piece of the product and see your impact firsthand.

We're building an AI-native engineering culture where engineers take ownership of problems, not just implementation. We expect you to question assumptions, challenge decisions, contribute to product direction, and find better ways to solve customer problems.

You'll use AI throughout the development process to move faster without compromising quality. Your responsibility doesn't end when code reaches production. You'll care about whether what we built actually works, delivers value, and solves the problem we set out to address.

 

You Will

  • Own problems end to end, from discovery and design to production and iteration. You take initiative instead of waiting to be told.
  • Build, test, and maintain features across the stack, with clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
  • Build modern applications with React, TanStack Router, and modular-react on the frontend, and Node.js, Fastify, Drizzle on the backend.
  • Work in a Dockerized TypeScript environment with Vitest and Playwright for testing.
  • Partner with Product and Design to shape what we build, focusing on outcomes for customers rather than sheer output.
  • Champion AI-native engineering across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and help the team raise the bar on speed and quality.
  • Run what you build by taking part in the on-duty rotation for the services you're responsible for and leading the improvements that keep them reliable.
  • Mentor other engineers and champion engineering excellence.

 

You Must Have 

  • 5+ years of experience building and maintaining production software, with strong hands-on experience in Node.js, TypeScript, and React, and the ability to work across different systems and technologies.
  • Strong full-stack fundamentals: modern frontend architecture (component design, state management, performance), API design, message queues (SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, or similar), relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), and cloud (AWS or similar).
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar). You've developed effective ways of working with AI to move faster, solve complex problems, and deliver high-quality software.
  • A strong product engineering mindset. You build with the customer in mind and measure success by the impact you deliver, not the tasks you close.
  • A strong sense of ownership. You're self-driven, proactive, and accountable for results well beyond the merge.
  • Strong collaboration skills. You work effectively with engineers, Product, Design, and other stakeholders to solve problems together. You share knowledge, give and receive constructive feedback, challenge ideas respectfully, and help others succeed.
  • A track record of leading complex projects end to end, from technical design to production rollout.
  • Strong quality and testing habits (unit, integration, and beyond) that let you ship fast without breaking things.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication skills, attention to detail, and a genuine drive to keep learning in a fast-paced, remote setting.

 

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience working in an open-source community as a maintainer or a contributor.
  • Familiarity with the localization industry and software localization. 

 

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.
🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.
🏢 Co-working budget — for those days you want a change from your home office.
🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.
🖥️ Home office setup budget — monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.
📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.
🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.
🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.
🤝 Great startup culture — remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

raw.title: Product Engineer
raw.description:
About Us

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We're the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals' health than ever.

The traction speaks for itself: founded in 2023 and already one of Europe's top 100 AI startups, with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 1M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London. We've attracted exceptional people from the likes of Palantir, Google, DeepMind, BCG, Meta, and AWS and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we're looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.

In this role, you will:

  • Own features end-to-end across the full stack (you could be leaning either frontend or backend), from API design to React interfaces to database migrations

  • Ship real, user-facing product that reaches vets and pet owners every single day

  • Help shape how the engineering team works as we scale.. Early hires leave fingerprints here

  • Collaborate closely with product and design, moving fast and debating well

  • Take on real ownership and responsibility from day one: no lanes, no waiting

Your background looks something like:

  • Engineering experience in tech and product-driven environments

  • Strong, practical command of TypeScript, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL

  • A genuine track record of shipping user-facing features at pace in a startup or high-growth environment

  • Experience at a Series A/B startup, high-throughput B2B SaaS, or consumer tech business (nice to have)

  • Familiarity with Terraform, Docker, AWS, or GitHub CI/CD (nice to have)

As a person, you:

  • Get restless when you can't see the whole problem and love owning it end-to-end

  • Take genuine pride in what you ship, and care about what users actually experience

  • Can take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, and make smart calls without constant direction

  • Are excited to work in-person from our Paddington, London HQ (Hybrid)

  • Thrive in a fast-moving environment where the priorities are real and the pace is relentless

What does success look like in 6 months?

  • You are shipping independently, scoping and building features that users love without needing to be unblocked at every step.

  • You have built real trust with the team by being humble, direct, and dependable.

  • People come to you not just to get things done but because they want your input on problems that are still half-formed.

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Asset Sales
raw.description:
Join our expanding engineering team!

We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event-driven microservices and help shape what AI-native engineering looks like at M-KOPA.

The Impact 💚

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under-banked populations

🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets

🤖 AI-native from day one: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on

🌍 Fully distributed: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end-to-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

Technical Environment 💻

  • Modern C# stack: Distributed C# and .NET microservices

  • Cloud & orchestration: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes

  • Architecture: Event-driven, supporting products used at significant scale

  • Observability: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics

  • AI tooling: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

  • AI-native engineering: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works

  • Guardrails as we accelerate: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship

  • Own it beyond the pull request: Design for idempotency, retries, out-of-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production

  • The Campfire Rule: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them

  • On-call as feedback, not heroics: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

What You Need

We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

Required Experience:

  • Strong grasp of C# and .NET development

  • Experience with event-driven systems - We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)

  • Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes

  • Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour

  • Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)

  • DevOps culture mindset, including on-call/production ownership

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones

  • Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

Location & Benefits

  • Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus, Growth Shares & On-Call Allowance

  • Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • Personalised training budget to support your development

  • Home office setup budget

  • Professional development programs and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

raw.title: Principal Engineer - Platform
raw.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We want our engineers to ship regulated medical software as fast as AI now lets them write it. Our software includes medical device software, holds members’ health data and keeps our clinics running, so every change has to be tested, traceable and ready for an auditor, and that is what makes this problem hard and worth solving.

 

You’ll build the shared AI engineering platform that makes it possible, setting the architecture and writing much of it yourself: a golden path that makes the best way to build with AI the default for every team, agents that do real engineering work end to end, and a pipeline that proves compliance on every change instead of documents written after the fact. This is a director-level individual contributor role, one of the first Principal Engineer roles in our software organisation, working directly with our Chief Software Officer. You make the key calls on which agents and tools we build or adopt, and you take on the hardest problems across teams, some of which reach clinic devices and the test rigs that recreate a scan room.

 

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • 0→1 set the target architecture for the AI engineering platform, including the build or adopt decisions on agents, orchestration and developer tooling

  • Ship a golden path for AI-assisted engineering, with shared context, tools and guardrails, that teams choose because it is the fastest way to ship

  • Put agents to work on real engineering jobs end to end, such as feature implementation, code migrations, automated review and on-call triage

  • Run agents in sandboxed environments with audit trails and clear separation from member health data

  • Shorten the path from merged code to production for regulated software: safe releases, fast rollback, and compliance evidence produced by the pipeline

  • Measure what changes with numbers engineers trust, such as the share of agent pull requests that get merged and how long a change takes to reach production, and share them openly

  • Take on the hardest cross-team technical problems, inside and beyond the platform, where no one has the answer yet

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • You have designed and built platforms or core infrastructure that other engineers relied on every day, and you wrote a meaningful part of the code yourself

  • Deep backend and distributed systems experience in production, with the judgement to make architecture calls in a large, existing codebase

  • Your own engineering is AI-first: you use agents for work you used to do by hand, and can explain where they help, where they fail, and what changed in speed and quality

  • You take a clear position on hard technical questions with incomplete information, defend it with reasons, and change it when the evidence changes

  • Engineers outside your own team changed how they work because of something you built and the technical case you made for it

  • Able to work from our London, New York or Stockholm office

     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with durable workflow orchestration, for example Temporal or Azure Durable Functions, and a clear view on when it is worth it, since long-running agent work has to survive failure

  • Work where software meets hardware or physical operations, such as connected devices, edge computing or hardware-in-the-loop testing

raw.title: Senior Vascular Sonographer
raw.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are growing our vascular team and building out the follow-up pathway that sits behind the Neko Body Scan. When a scan raises a vascular flag, such as a low ankle-brachial index, a difference in blood pressure between the arms, or asymmetry on our Spectrum Gen 2 imaging, a member is referred for a follow-up examination. You will carry out those examinations.

This is a senior role within a small, close team. You will scan and report your findings, work closely with our Vascular Specialist, who makes the clinical decisions and referrals, and help shape how the pathway runs as it scales. You will also be a vascular reference point for the doctors and operators who perform first-line measurements in our clinics.

What you will do

  • Perform and report arterial duplex ultrasound of the lower and upper limbs for members referred through the vascular follow-up pathway.

  • Carry out repeat ankle-brachial pressure index (ABPI) with Doppler, and toe pressures or toe-brachial index where the pathway calls for them.

  • Carry out the examination requested through the pathway, record your findings clearly and consistently, and report them to the Vascular Specialist, who decides the outcome and any onward referral.

  • Recognise findings that need urgent action, such as suspected critical or acute limb ischaemia, and escalate the same day through our agreed emergency pathway.

  • Flag it to the Vascular Specialist when a request does not fit what you find, explaining your reasoning, so they can decide the next step.

  • Support quality and pathway improvement: contribute to protocols and SOPs, take part in audit, and help us understand how well our thresholds and referral criteria perform in practice.

  • Maintain equipment, probe cleaning and infection control standards, and report faults promptly.

  • Where needed, cross-cover follow-up lists at our clinics in other cities, with notice and travel costs covered, so the pathway keeps running during leave and peaks in demand.

  • Uphold safeguarding, consent, confidentiality and information governance standards in all member contact.

What we are looking for

Essential

• Registered with the HCPC, or accredited as a vascular sonographer through a recognised route such as a CASE-accredited programme or the Register of Clinical Technologists [HR to confirm accepted routes].

• A recognised qualification in vascular ultrasound or vascular science (for example a postgraduate vascular ultrasound qualification or a clinical physiology degree with vascular specialism).

• Strong hands-on vascular ultrasound experience, with the ability to scan and report your findings accurately, or to reach that standard quickly with support from our team.

• Excellent communication. You explain what you are doing and finding clearly and kindly to members who may be anxious, and you pass on findings precisely to colleagues across clinical and non-clinical teams.

• Sound clinical awareness and the confidence to escalate. You recognise when a finding may be urgent and make sure the right person knows straight away. • Willingness to travel occasionally to cover our clinics in other cities. • Right to work in the UK

Desirable

  • Five or more years of experience, or experience supervising or training other clinicians in vascular technique.

  • Experience in a preventive, screening or private healthcare setting.

  • An interest in learning new vascular technologies.

  • Experience contributing to audit, service development or protocol writing.

  • Comfort working with digital clinical systems and structured reporting.

Working pattern

You will be based at our clinic in your city. We are hiring one vascular sonographer each in London, Manchester and Birmingham, and as a team you may occasionally be asked to cross cover another city. Cover is arranged in advance, and travel costs are covered.

raw.title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
raw.description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.

Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. The system must remain reliable with noisy GPS, in GPS-denied environments, and with outdated reference maps. Each pose estimate comes with an uncertainty that our customers rely on, and keeping it well calibrated across these conditions is part of the work.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and evaluate novel visual localization algorithms, combining 3D vision and deep learning.

  • Train large models on multi-modal data at scale, and build the benchmarks that measure their accuracy and robustness.

  • Develop robust solutions for difficult real-world conditions: noisy or denied GPS, changing appearance, varying capture quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

  • Work side-by-side with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping, as well as engineering and product teams, to identify the highest-impact problems and turn research into end-to-end solutions that operate at production scale.

  • Communicate results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, internal presentations, and publications.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, deep learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-view geometry and related problems, such as camera pose estimation, monocular depth estimation, SfM, SLAM, georeferencing, point-cloud registration, or sensor fusion.

  • Knowledge of transformer models for 3D vision, such as vision foundation models, feed-forward 3D reconstruction, or multi-view and multi-modal attention.

  • Knowledge of geospatial data and coordinate reference systems.

  • Ability to formulate ambiguous real-world problems, choose appropriate mathematical or learning-based tools, and evaluate solutions rigorously.

  • Strong Python skills and experience training deep learning models at scale, with libraries such as PyTorch, NumPy, and SciPy.

  • Strong software engineering skills, with the ability to turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.

  • Experience taking an algorithm from research idea and experimental prototype through evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment on real-world data.

  • Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate across research and engineering disciplines.

Nice to Have

  • A PhD in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, photogrammetry, geodesy, remote sensing, or a related field, or equivalent research or industry experience. A PhD is not required.

  • A strong publication record or substantial active involvement in the research community, especially at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, SIGGRAPH Asia, 3DV, ICRA, RSS, or related conferences and journals.

  • Experience with aerial or satellite imagery, GNSS/GPS, IMUs, LiDAR data, geodesy, mapping systems, or large-scale spatial data.

  • Evidence of technical leadership, mentorship, or successful cross-functional delivery.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.

Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed - you may be exactly who we're looking for.

Equal Opportunity

Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process.

Candidate Privacy

I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant-privacy-notice.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.

Lead every campaign

  • Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.

  • Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.

  • Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.

  • Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.

  • Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.

Build the playbook

  • Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.

  • Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.

  • Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.

  • Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.

  • Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.

  • Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.

  • Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.

🤩 About You

We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.

You'll probably have:

  • Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.

  • Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.

  • Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data.

  • A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies.

  • Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals..

  • The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines.

  • Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist.

  • The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

raw.title: Enterprise Sales Engineer
raw.description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

Solution Consulting sits at the center of how Omnea wins - deals are complex, cycles are competitive, and multiple stakeholders (finance, procurement, legal, risk) all need to be convinced simultaneously. You are the person who takes a messy, high-stakes, multi-threaded sales process and makes the future state obvious and credible, working strategically with the world's largest logos. You'll be sitting across the table from C-suite executives at companies going through massive transformation projects, at the center of decisions that reshape how they operate.

Solution Consulting is not an established playbook you're stepping into. You're building it. You'll decide how we sell, what our demos look like, how we structure technical validation, and how the function scales as the team grows. You won't be stepping into someone else's playbook. You'll be shaping the entire GTM motion for our most important market.

You'll own & define the technical and business case throughout the sales cycles - from discovery through demo(s), supporting RFPs, and defining the solution approach. That means translating a prospect's current-state, disconnected tools, broken workflows, poor adoption, into a compelling, specific vision of what Omnea makes possible, and building tailored demos across an expanding product surface spanning orchestration, risk, compliance, legal, sourcing, and AP. You'll partner directly with our GTM team to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder multi-country deal - and act as the voice of the market back into product and GTM: what's working, what's not, and what needs to change.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical strategy on our largest, highest-stakes enterprise deals: lead deep discovery across Heads of Procurement, IT, Security, and Finance, and translate what you uncover into a technical narrative compelling enough to justify a strategic investment, not just a tool purchase.

  • Multi-thread every stakeholder in the deal, from operational users to economic buyers, and navigate the political dynamics between teams that have never had to agree on a system before.

  • Scope, design, and own proof-of-concept projects end to end, combining a prospect's current state and processes within the Omnea platform to validate what that specific buying committee needs to see - not only a demo can run smoothly.

  • Present the outcome of a PoV and the roadmap to full implementation directly to executives up to C-level, framing the conversation around measurable ROI rather than a features checklist.

  • Build the reusable collateral, solution patterns, and demo frameworks that outlast your own deals: what you create should make every SE who joins after you productive faster than you were.

  • Mentor teammates on customer engagement and technical strategy, and help define what a great Solution Consultant at Omnea actually looks like, since the function itself is still being built.

  • Work hand in hand with Product: Bring competitive intelligence and prospect insight back from the field, and work with Product to shape what we build and how we position it.


What's Different About This Role

  • This is a career-defining chance to help build Omnea's GTM and Solution Consulting function from the ground up in the U.S., at a company that's still writing its playbook rather than handing you one.

  • You'll own complex enterprise deals end to end, working directly with AEs and senior customer stakeholders, which means you'll influence not just how individual deals get won but how the entire Solution Consulting function operates as it scales.

  • We're a flat, high-bar team where senior hires are expected to be self-directed from day one: you won't be eased in with a slow ramp or a junior support structure, you'll be trusted with real ownership immediately.

  • The company is on an incredibly strong growth trajectory with enterprise momentum behind it, which means the scope for you to create visible, immediate impact is significant rather than incremental.

  • Expect a genuinely meritocratic culture, one with high standards and direct feedback, where performance is recognized quickly and equity upside reflects the level of ownership and impact you actually have.

About you

Someone who thrives in this role is highly ambitious, genuinely energized by ambiguity and wants to influence how this function works from the ground up. They're also an exceptional individual contributor first: whatever they've been trusted with before, they've delivered on it.

  • 5-7+ years in enterprise sales engineering, solutions engineering, or senior technical consulting, ideally in B2B SaaS

  • A track record supporting high-contract-value enterprise deals - you know that winning one takes strategic positioning and deep discovery.

  • Comfortable working across large organizations with stakeholders at every level

  • Experience owning strategic accounts, mentoring others, or shaping solution strategy in a high-growth environment

  • An excellent communicator who can explain the same system to a procurement analyst and a CTO, and be credible to both

  • Proven as a top-performing individual contributor, with the ambition to go further: helping shape how the Solution Consulting function operates, not just working inside it.

  • Able to work from our New York office at least three days per week




At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Legal note: if you are viewing this posting outside of the Omnea careers' page, this may be an auto-generated advertisement and may lack the full range of advertised information - please click through to the posting at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/omnea to view additional advertised information on this posting.
Additionally, where roles have hard-specified requirements (e.g. [x] days in office, unable to provide visas, etc), if in your application you provide deterministic check-box confirmation that you do not meet the hard-specified requirements, deterministic (not AI or subjective) automatic rejection criteria are in place.

raw.description:
About the Role

OpenAI’s largest and most strategic customers are turning AI ambition into deployments that change how their organizations work. As a Delivery Lead, you will own delivery of priority AI initiatives for these customers, leading complex, high-impact deployments from planning through launch and adoption.

You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth.

This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. Lead complex customer engagements from scoping and planning through deployment, launch, and initial adoption.

  • Build and drive an integrated delivery plan. Establish clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures across customer, OpenAI, and partner teams.

  • Resolve blockers and drive decisions. Identify risks early, work through dependencies and resource constraints, and bring the right stakeholders together to resolve tradeoffs and keep delivery moving.

  • Lead launch readiness and activation. Drive rollout and enablement planning, address technical and organizational readiness gaps, and remove barriers to initial adoption and usage.

  • Connect delivery to customer value. Define expected outcomes and measurement approaches with customers and account teams. Track adoption and consumption, assess results against agreed baselines, and communicate the value achieved.

  • Provide a clear view of delivery health. Lead customer and internal delivery reviews that drive decisions and action. Communicate progress, launch confidence, risks, and implications for expected consumption and revenue timing.

  • Improve how we deliver. Turn customer experience into repeatable playbooks, practical tools, and actionable feedback for product and delivery teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise technology deployments, customer delivery programs, or transformation initiatives involving multiple teams and partners.

  • A track record of driving programs from scope through launch and adoption, with accountability for delivery commitments and measurable customer outcomes.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand AI systems, APIs, integrations, enterprise architecture, security dependencies, and deployment risks.

  • The ability to translate customer priorities into actionable delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures.

  • Strong judgment under ambiguity, including the ability to identify material risks, navigate competing priorities, and drive timely decisions.

  • Experience building trust with customers and leading across teams outside your reporting line while holding stakeholders accountable to shared commitments.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, technical specialists, and customer operators and explain complex delivery issues clearly.

  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how deployment, adoption, and consumption contribute to customer value and growth.

  • A practical approach to building repeatable delivery methods while adapting to the needs of individual

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
