raw.title: Engineering Manager, Guardian
raw.description:
About the Team

The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm.

Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products.

Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group.

About the Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and grow the Guardian team in London. You will own the engineering strategy and execution for production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users.

This is a builder-manager role with substantial technical depth. You will set direction, develop engineers, and create the operating cadence for a high-performing team, while remaining close enough to the work to shape architecture, review designs, debug difficult problems, and write code when it is the highest-leverage way to help the team move forward.

The role is highly visible and cross-functional. You will work closely with alignment researchers to translate emerging research into dependable systems, and with product teams to make agent safety a foundational capability across OpenAI.

This role is based in our London office.

In this role, you will

  • Lead, hire, and develop a London-based team of engineers working across agent safety, backend systems, applied AI, and product infrastructure.

  • Set the technical roadmap for Auto-review and the broader Guardian platform, balancing safety, product utility, latency, and operational reliability.

  • Build production systems that evaluate agent actions in real time, detect potentially harmful behavior, and support safe recovery or escalation paths.

  • Improve how oversight systems understand user intent, environmental context, permissions, and relevant personalization signals while protecting privacy and avoiding unnecessary friction.

  • Partner closely with alignment researchers to turn prototypes, evaluations, and new monitoring techniques into scalable product capabilities.

  • Work across Product, Security, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to integrate Guardian capabilities into agent experiences throughout OpenAI.

Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm.

raw.title: Strategic Account Director
Revenue Operations Manager
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organization. You'll set and execute the strategy for how we build revenue analytics across Salesforce and Looker, run insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business, partner closely with revenue leadership on the full range of topics they face, and, as you ramp up, take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

This is a generalist role by design: analytics is the foundation, especially in your first two quarters, and the role broadens from there to include business partnering and forecasting. What matters most is the versatility to move across all three, not depth in any single one.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Build a highly automated revenue insights engine using AI, while establishing yourself as the business partner revenue leadership.

  • First 12 months: Broaden into leading and supporting the forecasting cadence.


What Will You Be Doing?

Revenue Analytics & Insights

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider revenue leadership team rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Business Partnership to Revenue leadership

  • Become the go-to Revenue Operations partner for revenue leadership, covering reporting, insights, and the broader range of topics that come up in running a sales organization.

  • Translate revenue leadership's open questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Represent revenue's priorities into the Revenue Operations roadmap, and vice versa.

  • Support revenue leaders in business reviews, planning moments, and ad hoc requests with credible, fast turnaround.

raw.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
raw.description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Ping Identity is looking for a proactive Senior Field Marketing Manager to join the UKI region. This team has gone through a restructure in 2025 and while has the largest customer base in EMEA ,the objective is to drive geo growth in 2H 2026 and beyond.  There is considerable effort needed to boost brand awareness and create net new logo demand to achieve the regions' ambitious growth targets. 

This individual will be responsible for the UKI region, alongside a UKI Field Marketing Specialist. This innovative and forward-thinking marketing professional will partner closely with the UKI Sales leaders and Sales organisation and work with pan-EMEA Go To Market (GTM) teams to develop and implement a strategic integrated GTM plan, focusing on multi-touch campaigns that drive qualified pipeline.

Duty and Responsibilities:

  • Jointly work as part of the UKI leadership team and the Senior Manager Field Marketing for Northern Europe to develop the strategic approach required for success in region to drive exceptional growth
  • Work with internal parties and third-party vendors to develop and achieve our Go To Market vision in region
  • Execute the UKI plan with clear focus on delivering the metrics of success
  • Manage the day to day activity of the Field Marketing Specialist, ensuring growth and development
  • Review, refine and develop the GTM tactics on a regular basis to ensure continued engagement and penetration into the named strategic accounts
  • Work with the Pan-EMEA Programmes lead to create and execute vertical or use case led GTM plans for Account Executives to an enterprise audience (ABM 1:Few, 1:1, Deal acceleration programmes,)
  • Provide articulate feedback on the campaigns, analysis of success and next steps
  • Participate to the quarterly QBRs reporting on successes and outlining future strategies and tactics
  • Responsible for budget and procurement processes, auditing and accountability for budget spend and management

 

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or in a related field.
  • A minimum of 2-3 years' experience in Senior Field Marketing role
  • Previous experience in the IT industry, ideally in a technology B2B SAAS environment
  • Knowledge of current digital marketing technologies and techniques.
  • Working knowledge of SFDC and Marketo.
  • Great relationship building and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Positive attitude and work collaboratively. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong initiative and ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Qualifications:

  • A marketing or related business degree or equivalent

Working Conditions:

  • Travel – approximately 30% travel, mostly within the UKI region but some within Europe or US
  • Remote working contract with occasional travel to our London and Bristol based offices to work alongside the regional Sales Development Reps

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

raw.description:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Product Engineer owns the surfaces people actually work in. A coordinator planning a month of inspections across a fleet of auditors. A reviewer signing off on a technical file. These are dense, stateful workflows where the interface carries real consequences, and where the person using it has done the job for twenty years and will know immediately if the software doesn't understand it.

You own product surface end to end: the interface, the backend that supports it, and the data model underneath. Every customer runs the work differently, so there's no template to fall back on. You decide what the right thing to build is, build it, and are the one who hears about it when it's wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about raw engineering strength than about matching a list of technologies. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, C++ or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, speed and standards are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've built something hard and put it in front of real users. Not a prototype, not a course project. Something that ran, broke, and got fixed.

  • You build genuinely good interfaces, and you can go as deep on the backend as the feature requires.

  • You can hold a complicated workflow in your head and find the version of it that's simple enough to ship.

  • Speed with taste. You ship fast, and you're opinionated about what not to build.

  • You go to the source. You'll read the customer's actual documents, join the actual call, and look at hundreds of real outputs.

Signals we like, none of them required:

founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, early engineer at a startup with a serious engineering culture, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup, design sense you can defend, open source you genuinely maintain.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

raw.title: Director of Engineering - Content Platform (Catalog)
raw.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.

As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.

We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.


What You'll Do
  • Lead and develop multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, supporting their growth and impact.
  • Own and drive the technical strategy for a critical platform domain, aligning it with broader company and platform goals.
  • Enable teams across Spotify to build product experiences efficiently by improving the underlying catalog systems.
  • Guide the evolution and modernization of complex legacy systems into scalable, reliable architecture.
  • Partner closely with product and cross-functional leaders to align priorities and drive execution.
  • Improve system reliability and reduce operational friction in workflows that directly impact content availability.
  • Identify and apply opportunities for automation and AI to improve data quality and engineering productivity.
  • Build an inclusive engineering culture where teams continuously improve how they work and deliver.
  • Develop and execute a long-term roadmap that balances immediate priorities with strategic investments.

    • Who You Are
  • You have experience leading engineering organizations through other leaders and scaling teams effectively.
  • You have worked on complex, data-intensive systems where accuracy, consistency, and reliability at scale are critical.
  • You bring strong system design and architectural decision-making experience in distributed systems.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and making thoughtful trade-offs in high-impact environments.
  • You have experience evolving legacy systems and guiding long-term platform transformations.
  • You influence effectively across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
  • You have experience leading distributed teams and creating alignment across locations.
  • You communicate clearly and can explain complex technical topics to a range of audiences.
  • You are curious about how AI and automation can improve systems and workflows and apply that thinking pragmatically.
  • You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where teams can grow and do their best work.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions (Premium Desirability)
raw.description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.


What You Will Do
  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Premium awareness, acquisition, and activation, helping more listeners discover its value and take the next step toward subscribing.
  • Lead the discovery, development, and launch of consumer-facing product experiences, from early ideas and testing through to global rollout.
  • Shape how people experience Premium across Spotify and partner channels, creating engaging journeys that build consideration, encourage subscription, and support long-term retention.
  • Collaborate with partnerships and commercial teams to develop, launch, and scale subscription offerings across partners, markets, and audience segments.
  • Lead experimentation to understand what drives interest in Premium, using A/B testing and behavioral insights to improve the user journey and measure business impact.
  • Turn customer insights, market trends, and performance data into clear product opportunities, measurable goals, and informed priorities.
  • Balance user needs, business outcomes, partner requirements, and regional differences to make thoughtful product decisions that deliver sustainable growth.
  • Bring teams together around a shared direction, communicating product strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leaders.

    • Where You'll Be
  • You have a strong track record in product management, building and launching consumer-facing products at scale, with experience in areas such as subscriptions, consumer growth, marketplaces, media, or partner ecosystems.
  • You understand what makes a product valuable to consumers and how product experiences, positioning, and messaging influence consideration and willingness to pay.
  • You know how to identify opportunities across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion and retention, and connect product decisions to subscriber and revenue growth.
  • You're confident designing experiments, interpreting A/B tests, and using funnel, cohort, and behavioral data to make informed product decisions.
  • You have experience working across different markets and customer segments, balancing globally consistent experiences with local needs and opportunities.
  • You bring sound product judgment, knowing when to improve an existing experience, explore a new approach, or invest in longer-term capabilities.
  • You're a thoughtful communicator and collaborative partner who can bring together diverse perspectives, influence decisions, and align cross-functional teams around shared goals.
  • You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, testing assumptions, learning from outcomes, and adapting your approach as new insights emerge.

    • Where You Will Be
  • This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

raw.title: Founding UI/UX Artist, Unannounced Game
raw.description:
This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social.

As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell.

What You'll Be Doing

  • UX flow design for entire game experience

  • Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations

  • Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance

  • Discover and manage external partners where needed

What You Have

  • 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games

  • Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows

  • Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists

  • Passionate about both UI & UX design

  • Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.)

  • Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • At the forefront with AI tools and actively experimenting

  • Enjoys TCGs

Where You'll Be

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.

Supercell New Games

This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun.

You build the rocket. We bring the launchpad.

Game-changing Financial Model

Supercell is great with stuff around benefits and wellbeing, but most importantly you get to focus on what matters: making games. Skip the Venture Capital pitch decks and looking at runway spreadsheets. In exchange, we're offering a compensation model that makes this opportunity financially life-changing.

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Wishing you all the best,

raw.title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
raw.description:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

raw.title: Senior Product Designer
raw.description:
Senior Product Designer

LONDON / PRODUCT & DESIGN / FULL-TIME

Theodo UK builds digital products with cross-functional teams of engineers and product managers embedded directly with clients. Until now, design support mostly came from other entities in the Theodo group.

As our UK projects grow in complexity and ambition, we want to build stronger design capability locally. And for that, we are looking for our first Senior Product Designer in the UK.

Someone hands-on enough to solve real product problems day-to-day, but also able to help shape how design evolves inside the business.

You’ll work directly with the leadership team, product teams and engineers to design digital products, facilitate discovery work, support pitches and improve how teams build products together. This is a highly visible role.

You will help clients solve complex UX and UI challenges while also helping Theodo UK grow its design capability internally.

What You’ll Work On

At Theodo UK, designers are not isolated from delivery.

You’ll work inside cross-functional product teams alongside engineers and product managers to:

  • Solve UX and UI challenges on digital products
  • Facilitate discovery workshops and product discussions
  • Translate business problems into user-centred experiences
  • Design interfaces that are pragmatic, scalable and implementation-ready
  • Contribute to pitches, prototypes and strategic client conversations
  • Help teams make better product decisions

Projects can range from:

  • Early-stage MVPs
  • Scaleup product redesigns
  • Internal operational tools
  • Mobile applications
  • Complex B2B platforms
  • Discovery and innovation work

You’ll also help improve how design is embedded within Theodo UK itself.

As our first UK-based Senior Product Designer, you’ll help raise the quality and consistency of design across projects, contribute to sales conversations, and help shape the future of design within the business.

About you

  • 5 years of product, UX, or enterprise software design experience.
  • Experience working within Agile product development environments.
  • You enjoy fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly and where people are encouraged to contribute beyond their immediate role.
  • You are excited by the idea of joining a company where design is still growing and where you can have real impact.
  • Experience designing complex workflow-based applications.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating business impact and product thinking.
  • Expert proficiency with Figma and modern design tooling.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted design, generative AI, copilots, or agent-based experiences.
  • It is a strong plus if you are from a digital consultancy and have worked in cross-functional agile delivery environments

What We Offer

  • 25 Days annual leave
  • Learning and Development support throughout your career at Theodo
  • Private Health Insurance via Vitality
  • 3 week work from anywhere policy
  • Equipment budget for your tech set up
  • Company pension
  • Monthly Socials
  • A Slack network of 700+ “Theodoers” across our extended ecosystem — ask questions, share patterns, or troubleshoot obscure challenges with some of the sharpest minds out there
  • A hybrid working model, with offices based in London

offer.title: Senior Sales Director (RVP), Consumer Industries UK&I

raw.title: Senior Sales Director (RVP), Consumer Industries UK&I
raw.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As RVP, Consumer Industries, you will own and grow UiPath's Consumer Industries business across the UK & Ireland — spanning Retail, Travel & Hospitality, Media and Telecommunications. You will build and lead a high-performing enterprise sales organisation, combining strategic account leadership with new-business growth, to deliver transformational value for our largest and most strategic customers.

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Operate in harmony with our values: Humble, Bold, Immersed, and Fast

  • Develop and execute the go-to-market strategy for Consumer Industries across the UK & Ireland, building a sustainable, scalable growth plan aligned to company objectives

  • Build and lead a differentiated sales team spanning strategic account management, enterprise growth and new-business hunting, each with a distinct playbook and clear ownership

  • Grow our largest strategic accounts through executive sponsorship, multi-year account planning and consistent value realisation

  • Expand UiPath's footprint within existing customers by opening new buying centres and driving adoption of new solution areas

  • Lead new-logo acquisition against a clearly defined ideal customer profile, generating and converting a healthy new-business pipeline

  • Communicate and align strategy across UiPath's Eco System of GSI's, Focus Partners, and Technology and Academic alliances to extend customer impact

  • Head up monthly & quarterly business review cadence with account sponsors, to track progress on priorities and targets. Establish reference accounts

  • Create a culture of high performance, with a focus on measurable talent development, inclusion, wellbeing, fun and representing UiPath values in every interaction with customers, partners and colleagues

  • Remain at the leading edge of a fast-paced innovation in AI/Automation to ensure UiPath provide thought leadership to impact our customers' mission-critical business challenges today and tomorrow

  • Ensure a psychologically safe environment for your team, based on the servant leadership principle

What you'll bring to the team

  • Extensive experience building, managing and coaching a high performing enterprise sales team and creating a winning culture

  • Ability to define and execute industry GTM strategy, with a demonstrable track record of executing GTM strategies in an enterprise software business

  • Experience leading differentiated sales models — for example, distinct strategic account, growth and new-business hunting motions — rather than a single generic sales role

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding sales targets

  • Domain credibility in Consumer, Retail, Travel & Hospitality, Media or Telecommunications, or a closely related enterprise vertical

  • Extensive experience working in a value driven sales environment

  • Experience providing executive sponsorship on strategic, complex, and competitive opportunities; immersed, customer facing, and in a solution-oriented capacity

  • Excellent analytical and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to cross-functional audiences

  • The skill to build, manage, and nurture relationships at senior executive level, both internally and externally

  • Proven success in structuring and closing multi-million-dollar deals

  • Willingness to travel (40% to 60%) of time, as required for customer engagements

  • Experience of adopting rigorous sales methodologies ensuring accurate forecasting

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

offer.title: Senior Sales Development Representative  - German Speaking (Remote)

raw.title: Senior Sales Development Representative  - German Speaking (Remote)
raw.description:
We’re a growing team, and as we scale, so does our need to focus on expanding our sales development team. You’ll join a people-focused business that is putting AI at the center of how manufacturers and distributors price, quote and manage incentives, with a real opportunity to accelerate your career in enterprise SaaS sales.

As a Senior Sales Development Representative, you will identify and engage our ideal customers using Vendavo’s target account profile. You will lead the first stage of the customer journey, starting conversations and building early relationships through outbound prospecting, targeted campaigns, events and coordinated marketing activity.

You will guide prospects through the early stages of the commercial lifecycle: discovering opportunities, qualifying interest and fit, and securing high-quality meetings for our Account Executives. You will also support the account team on key marketing activity. Your work lays the foundation for predictable, high-quality pipeline across our enterprise segment.


THE OPPORTUNITY
  • Leverage research and tailored outreach to create new opportunities with both New Logo accounts and existing customers.
  • Run outbound prospecting (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) on strategic target accounts using concise, research-led messaging. Most of your quota will be expected to come from outbound.
  • Qualify inbound leads against set criteria, using strong questioning to identify true fit and move the right opportunities forward.
  • Research the business issues affecting target accounts and profile key contacts before outreach.
  • Build a solid understanding of our technology and solutions, and clearly explain the problems we solve and the value we deliver to prospects.
  • Lead team meetings on relevant topics, share learnings and new strategies to improve SDR performance, and take part in weekly pipeline reviews.
  • Monitor social media for relevant trends and keywords, and share insights with the SDR, marketing and content teams.
  • Assist in the mentorship and training of new SDRs on process, technology and the company, and act as a leader and problem solver for the team.
  • Support the sales cycle through forecasting, data management and clear communication. Co-own sales tech stack reporting, review insights weekly and recommend changes to process, people or procedures.
  • Contribute to and lead team meetings on a monthly basis on topics relevant to the role. 
  • Pipeline review with weekly team meeting 
  • Other duties as assigned. 

    •  

     


    THE SKILL SET
  • Minimum of 5 years related work experience; bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Consistent track record of meeting and exceeding lead generation and new account development objectives.
  • Fluent English and German speaker.
  • Excellent communication skills in writing, speaking, listening, and outbound calling - able to communicate clearly, concisely, and with precision.
  • Proficiency in our sales tech stack, or the ability to become proficient quickly: Salesforce (CRM, pipeline and reporting), Gong (email outreach and engagement tracking), Common Room (contact enrichment, prospecting and intent data) and Claude (research, account planning and outreach).
  • Stays current with AI and prospecting tools, and tests and applies them to improve outreach quality and efficiency.
  • Experience calling into Fortune 1000 accounts preferred.
  • Ability to understand and successfully promote technical offerings and solution sets, supported by strong curiosity about business problems and product value.
  • Highly motivated and positive, with an entrepreneurial, self-starting mindset and strong planning skills.
  • Demonstrated coachability - you seek feedback, apply it quickly, and continuously refine your approach.
  • Creative approach to outreach, with the ability to build sequences and test new messaging and cadences across email, phone and social channels.
  • Strong self-learning mindset: proactive in developing your sales craft through reading, testing, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong ownership mentality - takes responsibility for pipeline creation, follow-through, and results without outsourcing challenges.
  • Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift efforts based on business goals and team needs.
  • Strong working knowledge of Claude, including running account and contact research, creating and maintaining projects with reusable context, using and building Claude skills for repeatable workflows (research, call prep, sequence drafting), and checking outputs before they reach a prospect.
  • Ambitious about long-term career growth in sales, with a clear desire to progress into quota-carrying roles.
  • Must be able to travel as needed (For marketing / sales events and internal meetups in Europe and Sales Kick-Off in the U.S) 

    • THE BENEFITS
  • Fully remote based with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the UK
  • Flexible working hours
  • Working within a team of friendly, skilled people where help is always within reach
  • 25 vacation days per year in addition to public holidays
  • 4 recharge days, where the entire company goes on a brief pause in all geographies for 1 day each quarter. This day can be spent in whatever way helps you recharge, to regain energy, and dive back into the next workday
  • 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Income Protection Insurance
  • Accident Insurance
  • Pension Salary Exchange Scheme
  • Optional Medical Insurance
  • Travel insurance for business travels
  • Cell phone allowance up to 80£ per month
  • High-end laptop (Windows or Mac)
  • Competitive pay and bonus/commission
    •  
    THE VENDAVO STORY 
    Vendavo partners with the world’s leading companies to accelerate growth and profitability, advance innovation, and build more prosperous communities. Our powerful, cloud-based, AI-powered pricing, selling, and prescribing solutions empower global manufacturers and distributors to manage, optimize, and digitize their end-to-end commercial processes. But we offer so much more than software. Our proven, repeatable process, and passionate, experienced people accelerate value and drive profitable, unrivaled business outcomes for our customers. We are passionate about helping our customers deliver the right products, at the right prices, at the right time, for the right people. 
     
    OUR SAAS PRODUCTS 
    Our B2B pricing and selling solutions include Vendavo’s Pricing & Strategy Management (Pricepoint, Enterprise Pricing Platform, Deal Price Optimizer, and Vendavo AI), Sales & Quoting Solutions (Intelligent CPQ and Sales Optimizer), Profit and Margin Analytics (Profit Analyzer and Margin Bridge Analyzer), and Incentive & Channel Operations (Rebate and Channel Manager).  You can learn more about our products here.
     
    OUR FUNDING
    We are backed by two of the top high-tech private equity firms in the world, have excellent financial health, and boast the top SaaS retention in our space.
     
    OUR CULTURE & YOU
    We collaborate with our customers unlike any others in our industry. Anchored in our values (Integrity, Customer Centricity, Innovation, Clarity, Collaboration), we are growing, constantly innovating, and consistently driving sustainable outcomes for our clients and partners.
     
    Unlocking opportunities for our customers would not be possible without our employees. When you are part of Vendavo, you’re part of a company that’s committed to your growth and invested in your career. Diversity, inclusion, and celebration of community are at our core, and we come together to learn from each other and honor our commitments.
     
    EMEA and California residents applying for positions at Vendavo can see our privacy policy here.
     
    OUR TEAM IS GROWING. YOU WILL TOO.

raw.title: Broker Account Manager
raw.description:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

 

The challenge

The Broker Channel is Wayflyer's fastest-growing route to market, and growth like that doesn't manage itself. We need someone who can scale a panel of brokers into a genuine growth engine, turning relationships and referral volume into closed deals. This isn't a maintenance role. It's a build role.

What you'll actually do

  • Grow and manage our broker panel, bringing on new brokers and training them to properly understand and sell our products

  • Build real relationships with existing brokers, the kind that make them think of you first when a deal comes up

  • Review referrals and provide sense checks and indicative offers, reading business financials well enough to spot what matters

  • Own your portfolio end to end, converting referral volume into funded deals, not just noise in the pipeline

  • Represent Wayflyer at industry events and in broker networks, building our name as much as your own

What this role could turn into

Brokers are a key focus area for the business, so whoever takes this on gets a real say in shaping it, not just executing someone else's plan. From here, that can mean leading a regional broker team as we expand into new regions, or stepping into a wider commercial partnerships role across the business.

Who thrives here

Someone who treats brokers as partners, not leads, and understands that a broker's reputation is on the line every time they refer you a deal. You're commercially sharp, comfortable with numbers, and genuinely curious about the businesses behind the applications, not just the credit markers. You don't wait for a case to be handed to you in a tidy format. You chase it down, sense-check it, and move.

We hire for range

We're looking for someone who's spent at least 2 years in business lending, ideally in fintech, and at least 2 years working directly with commercial finance brokers, with a real network to show for it. You'll have at least a year analysing business financials at a working level, and Hubspot experience is a bonus. More important than the years is the trajectory: have you built something, grown a book, or turned relationships into revenue? We'll also consider exceptional candidates from adjacent areas of business finance who don't tick every box.

Location and working policy

📍London, hybrid (3-4 days)

 

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.

raw.title: Director of Data Engineering
raw.description:
Working at WGSN
Together, we create tomorrow 


A career with WGSN is fast-paced, exciting and full of opportunities to grow and develop. We're a team of consumer and design trend forecasters, content creators, designers, data analysts, advisory consultants and much more, united by a common goal: to create tomorrow. 


WGSN's trusted consumer and design forecasts power outstanding product design, enabling our customers to create a better future. Our services cover consumer insights, beauty, consumer tech, fashion, interiors, lifestyle, food and drink forecasting, data analytics and expert advisory. If you are an expert in your field, we want to hear from you. 

About the Role

We're hiring a Director of Data Engineering to own WGSN's data platform: its architecture, its data models and how it runs day to day. You'll report to our Group Chief Data Officer, lead a team of five data engineers, and work closely with our Group Technology, Data Science and programme teams.

At the heart of the role is the trend spine, the connected backbone that links trend signals, taxonomies, forecasts and content. Next year we launch an expanded social data product across TikTok, Reddit and Instagram, and after that we plan to rebuild the platform. You'll lead both, and lay the data foundations for the AI products that will sit on top.

What You'll Do

  • Own data architecture and modelling across the WGSN platform
  • Design and build the trend spine
  • Integrate structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, from social and search signals to runway imagery and proprietary research
  • Lead, develop and set standards for a team of five engineers, plus agency and contractor partners
  • Lead architecture discussions with our Group Technology team
  • Shape the planned platform rebuild, including stack, cost and vendor decisions
  • Introduce AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices and build AI-ready data foundations
  • Make sure the platform is reliable, well governed, GDPR compliant and cost effective

What We're Looking For

  • Experience designing or substantially reshaping a data platform, with clear ownership of architecture and modelling decisions
  • The technical depth and confidence to lead engineering and architecture conversations with senior technologists
  • Data engineering leadership at a small to mid-size business, or at manager level in a larger organisation with real design ownership
  • Hands-on experience with semi-structured and unstructured data alongside structured data

The role

We are looking to hire a Enterprise Account Executive - API Solutions to join our EMEA sales team in London. 

This is an on-site role out of our London office

 

Working at WGSN

Together, we create tomorrow 

A career with WGSN is fast-paced, exciting and full of opportunities to grow and develop. We're a team of consumer and design trend forecasters, content creators, designers, data analysts, advisory consultants and much more, united by a common goal: to create tomorrow. 

WGSN's trusted consumer and design forecasts power outstanding product design, enabling our customers to create a better future. Our services cover consumer insights, beauty, consumer tech, fashion, interiors, lifestyle, food and drink forecasting, data analytics and expert advisory. If you are an expert in your field, we want to hear from you. 

About the Role

We are seeking a high performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new logo acquisition for the WGSN Intelligence API.

For 28 years, WGSN has provided category-leading trend intelligence to the world’s top consumer brands. As enterprise clients rebuild their systems around AI, this role is responsible for selling high-value, direct API integrations that embed WGSN’s proprietary intelligence into client design tools, merchandising platforms, e-commerce environments, and AI agents.

This is a pure hunting role focused on closing complex, enterprise integration deals across fashion, beauty, retail, consumer goods, and fintech.

Key accountabilities

  • Pipeline Generation: Proactively source and build a net-new enterprise pipeline targeting C suite and VP level buyers (Chief Digital, Data, Innovation, and Product Officers).

  • Technical & Consultative Selling: Lead end-to-end sales cycles for complex, high-value API integrations. Conduct deep consultative discovery to map WGSN API capabilities directly to client technical architectures and business cases.

  • Deal Ownership & Orchestration: Direct the complete sales process from origination to signature. Strategically pull in internal technical specialists only when needed for deep scoping.

  • IP Protection & Commercial Discipline: Structure deals within established pricing and legal guardrails, ensuring strict protection of WGSN’s intellectual property, training-data exclusions, and brand attribution.

  • Pipeline & Forecast Management: Maintain accurate forecasting, deal stage hygiene, and pipeline coverage metrics.

Skills, experience & qualifications

  • Background in trend intelligence, syndicated consumer data, SaaS, or enterprise AI/ML platforms is preferred.

  • Consistent history of exceeding quotas in an individual contributor, net-new enterprise hunting role closing $1M+ multi-year deals.

  • Ability to independently lead technical discussions with senior data and technology buyers. Solid working knowledge of enterprise integration models, including REST/streaming APIs, authentication, and enterprise AI/ML architectures (e.g., RAG, embedded copilots, AI agents).

  • Expert at navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments across technical, product, and commercial business units.

  • Strong qualification discipline; ability to identify non-viable deals early and protect IP standards without compromising revenue goals.

  • Existing network of senior digital, data, and innovation leaders within Tier-1 retail and consumer brands preferred.

  • Familiarity with AI content licensing models, including training-data protections and brand attribution terms is preferred. 

What we offer

Our benefits and wellbeing package offers flexible benefits you can tailor to your own personal needs, including:  

- 25 days of holiday per year - with an option to buy/ sell up to 5 days
- Pension, Life Assurance and Income Protection Flexible benefits platform with options including Private Medical, Dental Insurance & Critical Illness 
- Employee assistance programme, season ticket loans and cycle to work scheme 
- Volunteering opportunities and charitable giving options  
- Great learning and development opportunities.


More about WGSN

WGSN is the global authority on consumer trend forecasting.

We help brands around the world create the right products at the right time for tomorrow’s consumer.


Our values 

We Are Everywhere
The future is everything, it happens everywhere. WGSN is the world-leading forecaster because we track and analyse consumer behaviours, product innovation, design and creativity, everywhere.

We Are Future Focused
We utilise our global resources and intelligence to research, source and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to produce our forecasts. Everything we do is focused on working with our customers to create a successful and positive tomorrow.

We Are Rigorous
We source, review and assess quantitative and qualitative data to produce robust, actionable forecasts. To provide credible insights and design solutions for our clients, it is essential that rigour runs through everything we do.


Our culture 

An inclusive culture is one of our key priorities. We want our people to truly be themselves and thrive. We love having a diverse team of people who bring new ideas, different strengths and perspectives & reflect the global audience we work with.


Inclusive workforce

We offer a flexible working environment with a wide range of flexible, hybrid and agile working arrangements. Conversations about flexible working have always been—and will continue to be—actively encouraged here, but we do not offer full remote working.

We use AI to help our team screen applications and identify candidates whose skills and experience match the role. This technology removes personal information to promote a fair and unbiased process. We believe this tool helps us find the best talent while maintaining transparency and fairness.


A Note for Recruiters 

Thank you so much for your interest in working with us at  WGSN!   Our internal Talent Acquisition team takes care of all our recruitment efforts. When we need some extra help, we partner with agencies on our Preferred Supplier List (PSL) that truly understand our business, culture and ways of working together.  Since we focus on these established partnerships, we’re unable to respond to unsolicited contacts or CVs from outside our PSL. But don’t worry! If we decide to explore new partnerships, we’ll be sure to reach out.

raw.title: Senior AI - Computer Vision Engineer - UK
raw.description:
Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer

Build the spatial AI behind the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is already being used on major construction projects around the world to help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

Our R&D team applies computer vision, spatial AI and machine learning to one of the most demanding real-world settings there is: the active construction site.

We’re looking for a Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer with deep expertise in 3D computer vision and spatial AI to join the team and help develop the perception technology behind our products.

As a Series B business entering our next phase of growth, we're investing in our R&D capability and growing our team. This great opportunity will be based out of our Angel, London office on a hybrid basis, 2-3 days per week.

The Role

This is an opportunity to solve computer vision problems that exist at the intersection of the digital and physical world.

You’ll develop the perception and scene-understanding systems that enable our wearable technology to recognise construction objects, understand complex 3D environments, and relate what’s on site to the design model, using real-world sensor data.

For this role, 3D / spatial computer vision expertise is fundamental. We’re looking for someone who understands how AI and computer vision can reason about physical space, not simply someone with broader AI or machine learning experience.

You’ll work across research, algorithm development, optimisation, deployment and productisation, taking sophisticated computer vision techniques and turning them into robust technology capable of performing on active construction sites.

You’ll bring senior technical expertise to the team as we build our capability and presence in Calgary. You’ll also collaborate closely with our Navigation, Embedded Software, Hardware and Product teams across the wider business.

This is a role where you can combine deep technical work with real-world impact, seeing the algorithms and systems you develop ultimately deployed through wearable technology on some of the world's most complex construction projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop advanced computer vision algorithms for construction scene understanding and spatial intelligence.

  • Design and develop semantic segmentation, object detection and instance segmentation models.

  • Build algorithms capable of understanding 3D environments, spatial relationships and physical geometry.

  • Develop automated BIM correspondence and object-matching capabilities.

  • Develop algorithms using multi-modal sensor data.

  • Combine AI, 3D vision, SLAM and BIM to develop geometric and spatial reasoning capabilities.

  • Explore emerging scene representation techniques including Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs.

  • Improve localisation-assisted perception and robustness across varying lighting, weather and real-world site conditions.

  • Design, train and evaluate large-scale deep learning models.

  • Develop data pipelines supporting supervised, self-supervised and semi-supervised learning.

  • Evaluate emerging foundation models, multimodal AI and modern computer vision techniques where they can add meaningful value.

  • Optimise models for embedded deployment, improving inference speed, accuracy and robustness.

  • Deploy and optimise models for embedded GPU platforms.

  • Build and improve production inference pipelines, benchmarking performance, latency and accuracy.

  • Contribute to technical architecture, design reviews and our technical direction.

  • Share knowledge and mentor other engineers as the team continues to grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years’ industrial experience in Computer Vision, with strong hands-on experience solving complex technical problems.

  • MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, AI, Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Experience with perception for autonomous or embodied systems, such as SLAM, sensor fusion or state estimation, would be valuable.

  • Deep expertise in 3D Computer Vision / Spatial AI, this is a core requirement for the role.

  • Strong understanding of geometry, spatial relationships and scene understanding.

  • Experience developing and deploying computer vision and deep learning systems in production.

  • Strong Python development skills and expert knowledge of PyTorch.

  • Experience with semantic segmentation, object detection, image understanding and modern computer vision architectures.

  • Experience designing and training large-scale deep learning models and working with large image datasets.

  • Strong mathematical foundations in machine learning and computer vision.

  • Ability to bridge research and production engineering, comfortable exploring emerging techniques while remaining focused on building robust, deployable products.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex, ambiguous technical challenges.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

What matters most for this role is genuine depth in 3D / spatial computer vision and the ability to apply that expertise to complex, real-world engineering problems.

We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about where computer vision and AI are heading, but who also has the practical engineering mindset to turn emerging research into technology that works reliably outside of the lab.

What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to some of our highest-priority R&D initiatives, including:

  • 3D construction scene understanding

  • Construction semantic segmentation

  • Automated BIM understanding and object correspondence

  • Spatial reasoning across wearable sensor data

  • Embedded AI deployment

  • Foundation models for construction understanding

  • Perception for wearable AR

Why Join Us

  • 🚀 Work at the intersection of Spatial AI, 3D Computer Vision, AR and real-world engineering

  • 🧠 Solve genuinely difficult perception and scene-understanding problems

  • 🥽 Develop AI that ultimately runs through physical, wearable technology – not just software on a screen

  • 🏗️ See your work applied to some of the world’s most ambitious construction projects

  • 📈 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

  • 🔬 Work alongside specialists across Computer Vision, AI, Navigation, Embedded Software and Hardware

  • 💡 Have meaningful influence over technical architecture and the future direction of our perception technology

  • 🌍 Build technology with tangible, real-world impact

If you’re passionate about 3D computer vision and spatial AI, enjoy solving difficult problems at the intersection of research and engineering, and want to see your work move from algorithms into technology being used in the physical world, we’d love to hear from you.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

As part of the trust team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline trust workflows, enhance decision-making around risk, and support responsible growth. The team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners — including Product, Operations, Legal, Marketing, and Engineering — to drive accountability, insights, and operational integrity across the business.

  • Leadership Partnership — Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership, delivering strategic insights, risk reporting, and actionable recommendations.

  • Data-Driven Strategy — Oversee analytics across trust functions. Identify risk patterns and areas for improvement; build dashboards and insights that inform policy decisions and guide operational improvements.

  • Reporting & Analytics — Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and KPIs that measure trust and safety performance and impact.

Who you are

  • Passionate about responsible AI and motivated by building systems that protect users and maintain platform integrity

  • Highly motivated with a strong work ethic — you understand the stakes of this moment in AI and are committed to getting it right

  • Analytical and first-principles oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex risk tradeoffs

  • Consistently deliver high-quality work quickly and take initiative from day one

  • Low ego, high ownership

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to translate complex risk data into clear recommendations

  • 4+ years in Security, Trust & Safety Operations, or Risk Operations at a high-growth technology company

  • Proven track record building end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis through to execution

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Policy, Legal, or Safety teams

  • Highly adaptable with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe. Preference for candidates based in London.

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

GM, Head of Data

We are seeking someone to lead the Talos data business and position it for strong, sustainable growth. You’ll own the P&L, product strategy and client relationships for our digital assets data offering, built on the Coin Metrics acquisition. Working closely with engineering, sales and executive leadership, you’ll shape how our data products are built, packaged and taken to market. This is a high-ownership role for an experienced business leader who has built or run a data business before and believes digital assets are where markets are heading.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the P&L for the data business, including revenue, costs, forecasting and performance reporting to executive leadership.

  • Set and execute product strategy: decide where to invest, what to scale and what to sunset, based on product traction and market demand.

  • Build a commercial model that serves both self-service customers and enterprise clients, including packaging, pricing and distribution.

  • Lead the research, product and data science teams, making sure research drives product development and supports Talos more broadly.

  • Partner with sales, marketing and engineering, which sit outside your reporting line, to align priorities and deliver revenue growth.

  • Own client outcomes and account health, resolving issues and driving retention and expansion.

  • Define the positioning and brand strategy for the data business within the wider Talos group.

  • Build a high-performing, motivated team with a strong sense of ownership and shared identity.

 

Qualifications

  • Proven experience leading a business unit or owning a P&L, ideally at a market data, index or financial data provider.

  • A track record of turning around or growing a business, with clear, measurable results.

  • Strong data product expertise, including monetisation, packaging, pricing and go-to-market for both self-service and enterprise models.

  • A background in capital markets. Digital assets experience is a plus, but a strong understanding of and conviction about the asset class is essential.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and deliver through cross-functional teams without direct authority.

  • Experience building and leading research, product or data science teams.

  • Sound commercial judgement and accurate forecasting.

  • Executive presence and the ability to engage and constructively challenge senior leadership.

  • A builder’s mindset, suited to fast-moving, entrepreneurial environments rather than established incumbents.
