raw.title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Merchant EMEA
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Fullstack Engineer (Go / Kotlin & React)

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

 

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

 

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

 

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

 

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.
  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

You can read more about our recruitment process here. here.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

raw.title: Software Platform Engineer, EU Traffic
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Company

Help us build the world's most reliable, on-demand logistics engine for last-mile delivery! We're bringing on experienced engineers to help us create and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers the company's three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and riders.

About the Role

We are looking for experienced engineers to join the EU Traffic team, based at Deliveroo, part of DoorDash, and help build the next generation of DoorDash's Traffic platform. We are building a single, shared platform designed to serve DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, so your work will shape reliability and security for all three marketplaces. Our team owns the infrastructure that carries every request into and through that platform: the edge, where we manage Cloudflare (CDN, DNS, rate limiting, bot mitigation) and the ingress systems for external traffic, and service-to-service (S2S) communication, where we run the service mesh and the authentication that secures calls between thousands of services across multiple regions.

You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including our Cloudflare edge configuration (managed as code), and service-to-service authentication and authorization (workload identity, token issuance and validation at the mesh layer). This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and security. It includes designing, building, and maintaining systems that must operate reliably and efficiently across some of the most critical and latency-sensitive workloads at DoorDash, from the first byte at the edge to the last hop between services.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the EU-Traffic Team within the Infrastructure organization. This role is hybrid working from London.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design and build large-scale distributed systems that are high RPS and latency sensitive
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and fix issues that affect production and maintain our SLAs
  • Work collaboratively with other platform and product engineers to deliver on feature requests and solve their problems
  • Find ways to improve the team's productivity and operational capabilities through the use of automation, AI tools, and other avenues
  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation and help lead production investigations and incidents, with support from teammates
  • Mentor and learn from teammates through design reviews, pairing, and incident reviews

We're excited about you because…

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer in infrastructure, networking, or platform engineering/SRE
  • Experience operating edge technologies at scale, such as CDN, WAF, proxy layers, and DNS
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals like TCP/IP, HTTP, HTTP/2, gRPC, Load Balancing
  • Background working on and debugging high-QPS or latency-sensitive systems
  • You're curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in ambiguity
  • You work AI-first: you delegate to and orchestrate coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across design, implementation, testing, incident response, and releases

If you don't meet every requirement but are excited about this work, we'd still love to hear from you.

Bonus points if you…

  • Experience with programming languages like Go, C++, Python or Rust
  • Experience with AWS, especially with networking primitives like LBs, Privatelink, etc. and Kubernetes or other container management tool
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Envoy, Istio or Linkerd
  • Familiarity with xDS or control plane architectures
  • Experience building RPC frameworks or client-side networking libraries
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling like Terraform
  • Experience with Gitops delivery tooling such as ArgoCD, Helm, Atlantis.
  • Track record of sharing prompts, tooling, and practices that make a whole team faster with AI

raw.title: Software Platform Engineer, EU Traffic
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Company

Help us build the world's most reliable, on-demand logistics engine for last-mile delivery! We're bringing on experienced engineers to help us create and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers the company's three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and riders.

About the Role

We are looking for experienced engineers to join the EU Traffic team, based at Deliveroo, part of DoorDash, and help build the next generation of DoorDash's Traffic platform. We are building a single, shared platform designed to serve DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, so your work will shape reliability and security for all three marketplaces. Our team owns the infrastructure that carries every request into and through that platform: the edge, where we manage Cloudflare (CDN, DNS, rate limiting, bot mitigation) and the ingress systems for external traffic, and service-to-service (S2S) communication, where we run the service mesh and the authentication that secures calls between thousands of services across multiple regions.

You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including our Cloudflare edge configuration (managed as code), and service-to-service authentication and authorization (workload identity, token issuance and validation at the mesh layer). This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and security. It includes designing, building, and maintaining systems that must operate reliably and efficiently across some of the most critical and latency-sensitive workloads at DoorDash, from the first byte at the edge to the last hop between services.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the EU-Traffic Team within the Infrastructure organization. This role is hybrid working from London.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design and build large-scale distributed systems that are high RPS and latency sensitive
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and fix issues that affect production and maintain our SLAs
  • Work collaboratively with other platform and product engineers to deliver on feature requests and solve their problems
  • Find ways to improve the team's productivity and operational capabilities through the use of automation, AI tools, and other avenues
  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation and help lead production investigations and incidents, with support from teammates
  • Mentor and learn from teammates through design reviews, pairing, and incident reviews

We're excited about you because…

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer in infrastructure, networking, or platform engineering/SRE
  • Experience operating edge technologies at scale, such as CDN, WAF, proxy layers, and DNS
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals like TCP/IP, HTTP, HTTP/2, gRPC, Load Balancing
  • Background working on and debugging high-QPS or latency-sensitive systems
  • You're curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in ambiguity
  • You work AI-first: you delegate to and orchestrate coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across design, implementation, testing, incident response, and releases

If you don't meet every requirement but are excited about this work, we'd still love to hear from you.

Bonus points if you…

  • Experience with programming languages like Go, C++, Python or Rust
  • Experience with AWS, especially with networking primitives like LBs, Privatelink, etc. and Kubernetes or other container management tool
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Envoy, Istio or Linkerd
  • Familiarity with xDS or control plane architectures
  • Experience building RPC frameworks or client-side networking libraries
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling like Terraform
  • Experience with Gitops delivery tooling such as ArgoCD, Helm, Atlantis.
  • Track record of sharing prompts, tooling, and practices that make a whole team faster with AI

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

raw.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 £30,000 - £35,000 + £8,400 OTE + Benefits

Our Account Executive role is the first step in your career within Sales @ Funding Circle! Here you will learn the foundations of sale starting with a tailored two week Sales Induction Programme on joining. From there, you will be given the on-going tools and support to thrive in your role and eventually progress into more senior roles such as Account Manager, all the way through to Sales Team Manager!

Our Account Executive roles are phone based and are the first point of contact with our Borrowers; speaking with them frequently during their Funding Circle journey. Every day you will speak to a diverse range of SME business owners to gain an understanding of their business, find out about their goals and explain how Funding Circle can help in achieving them.

  • Working with warm leads to generate new opportunities through business development of existing Funding Circle borrowers (c.60-80 dials per day)

  • Establishing instant rapport with your customers via telephone & email to cultivate successful relationships

  • Pitching the Funding Circle proposition against alternative funding options available

  • Managing a high-volume, fast-paced pipeline; supporting your clients through each stage of creating an application

  • Being responsible for your own monthly target and continuously developing & improving your approach to help you get there

  • Proactively problem solving, identifying and confidently mitigating any risks, issues or control weaknesses that arise in your day-to-day

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • Experience working in a sales or service environment - we don’t require heaps of experience but some exposure to a sales or service environment is beneficial

  • A strong communicator, confident to be able to engage with small business owners over the phone and via email

  • You’re able to proactively identify ways to use Generative AI to streamline your daily tasks and improve your personal productivity

  • Confident using approved AI tools safely and effectively to enhance your output and find a better way of working

  • Ability to continually develop and maintain your pipeline whilst managing applications in progress Proactivity and a desire to develop your career and taking onboard feedback - continuous development is a key part of sales at Funding Circle and we are looking for people keen to grow!

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

The Data Platform team builds and runs the platform that all Funding Circle data teams use. This includes our Snowflake platform, streaming and batch ingestion, orchestration, data contracts and the Data Product Portal.

We are in the middle of a big change. We are moving to Snowflake and to a federated "Data as a Product" model. This role will lead the engineering of that platform

  • Lead the technical direction of the Data Platform. Turn the target architecture into a clear, sequenced engineering plan, and keep the team aligned to it.

  • Own the technical quality of the platform: Snowflake infrastructure and RBAC, ingestion patterns, orchestration (Airflow), CI/CD, observability and cost controls.

  • Make and record technical decisions. Run the decision-document process. Make the final call when the team cannot agree, and escalate cross-domain decisions to the architecture review board.

  • Grow the team. Mentor engineers, spread knowledge so that no system depends on one person, and set a review culture that is fast and deep.

  • Make it easy for domain teams, Data Scientists, Analysts and AI Agents to build on the platform. Define standards and reusable patterns. Make sure that DP reviews do not block the domain teams, and work closely with the teams that use the platform.

  • Lead the platform side of the Athena → Snowflake migration: source landing, reconciliation and cutover evidence, and decommissioning of the legacy platform.

  • Own operational excellence with the Engineering Manager: on-call quality, alert quality, incident follow-ups, runbooks, and disaster recovery.

  • Own security and governance controls on the platform with Security and Data Governance.

  • Manage the technical relationship with platform vendors. This includes support cases, escalations and roadmap input.

  • Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and data leadership.

  • Set and evolve the team's standards for AI-assisted engineering, so that tools like Claude and Copilot are used safely and consistently.

  • Work closely with the Principal Engineer. The Principal owns the cross-domain architecture. You turn it into the platform engineering plan and make sure the team delivers it.

What we’re looking for 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

  • 8+ years in Data & Analytics, with proven experience as a Senior/Tech Lead setting architectural direction for other engineers

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Snowflake, including ideally Iceberg/open table formats and RBAC.

  • Advanced SQL, Python, and enterprise-grade dbt model development.

  • Experience designing end-to-end data pipelines. Combining batch, file-based, and streaming ingestion (Kafka/CDC) managed with Airflow orchestration.

  • A good understanding of data security and governance, including PII handling and access control.

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills and CI/CD skills.

  • Track record of writing clear design docs, explaining technical risks to non-technical stakeholders, and making decisions under uncertainty.

  • Data contracts (ODCS/ODPS), data product portals, lineage tools.

raw.title: Marketing & Events Coordinator
raw.description:
About Handshake

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

About the Role

We are growing our EMEA team and looking for a Marketing & Events Coordinator to help us show up brilliantly – for the employers and universities we work with, and for the students we exist to serve.

This role sits across both sides of our marketplace – B2B employer and agency activity, and D2C student-facing campaigns – so no two weeks look the same. You'll support our events calendar and social presence, work alongside agency partners and internal stakeholders, and build foundational marketing skills as part of the broader EMEA marketing team. You'll be hands-on: travelling to support events in person, coordinating with our agency, and learning what "good" looks like from the ground up, with guidance from your manager as you go.

This is a developing role reporting into the Growth Marketing Strategist. You won't be expected to have all the answers on day one – you'll be executing defined pieces of work with support, building judgement over time, and growing into broader ownership as you demonstrate impact.

Events

  • Support the planning and delivery of the annual EMEA events calendar, working closely with your manager, who sets priorities and provides guidance

  • Take ownership of individual events end-to-end under guidance – from logistics coordination to on-the-ground delivery

  • Travel to support and help deliver our B2B and D2C student events in person

  • Support day-to-day coordination with agency and suppliers, escalating issues or risks to your manager

  • Work with our designer to help bring creative concepts to life in event assets and signage

  • Sweat the details on-site – signage, run-of-show, logistics – to help ensure consistent quality

  • Capture and coordinate content from events, including photography, video and social assets

  • Support reporting on event performance (leads, engagement, attendance), learning what to track and why

Marketing

  • Support execution of the EMEA marketing strategy across B2B and D2C, as defined by senior marketing team members

  • Own day-to-day scheduling and publishing of the social media calendar (LinkedIn), within an editorial plan set by your manager

  • Coordinate campaign logistics across channels – email, social, events, content, website and paid – following established plans

  • Partner with the Growth and Sales teams to support alignment between marketing activity and commercial priorities

  • Build and maintain marketing assets, templates and collateral

Desired Capabilities

  • Strong organisational skills – you keep track of multiple tasks and follow through reliably, nothing falls through the cracks

  • High attention to detail across copy, logistics and data

  • A curious, creative thinker who's keen to contribute ideas and comfortable asking questions when facing ambiguity

  • A clear communicator, comfortable coordinating day-to-day with agency partners, colleagues and internal stakeholders

  • Energised by variety, and happy to pick up new kinds of tasks

  • 2+ years' experience in a marketing, events, or related role – internships count, and early-career candidates are encouraged to apply

Extra Credit

  • Ability to speak French or German would be a bonus

Perks

Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life.

The below benefits are for full-time UK employees.

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: Competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits

💝 Wellbeing: Medical insurance covering 100% of employee premiums, Critical Illness, Life & Group Income Protection

📚 Growth: £1,500 learning stipend, ongoing development

💻 Remote & Office: Internet stipend, commuting benefits, and free lunch on office days

🏝️ Time Off: 25 days holiday increasing with tenure

Compensation: £44K – £55K • Offers Equity

  • • £44K – £55K • Offers Equity

raw.title: Forward Deployed Finance Engineer, Private Credit
raw.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow.

Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals — screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials — built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work.

Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work.

This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows.

You may be asked to travel around 2–3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1–3 days at a time.

What You'll Do

Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the private credit team are former credit investors who left the desk to help build the future of how credit gets underwritten. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with direct lenders, opportunistic and specialty finance managers, BDC managers, and insurer credit arms throughout the pre-sales process and stay with them well past it — leading pilots on live opportunities, guiding lenders through what's possible with AI, and sitting down with credit teams to build screening, underwriting, and credit committee workflows in the firm's own templates and formats.

The work is the work they did on the desk: lender presentation and CIM review; QoE read-throughs and data pack analysis; cash flow and leverage modeling; sizing and structuring; covenant and credit agreement review; credit memo drafting; and comps. It continues post-close into compliance certificate review, covenant tracking, amendment and waiver analysis, and quarterly portfolio reporting, so value compounds after the first deal. Along the way, Finance Engineers bring credit-team feedback back into the product, helping shape the future of Harvey.

What You Have

  • 6+ years on the investment or underwriting team at a direct lender, private credit fund, BDC manager, or insurer private credit arm, with demonstrated ownership of live deal work: screening, underwriting, diligence workstreams, modeling, structuring, and drafting credit committee materials. Asset-based and specialty finance backgrounds are welcome. Leveraged finance, restructuring advisory, or rating-agency experience before the principal side is welcome, but principal-side deal execution is required.

  • Strong command of the documents and data that drive a credit decision — lender presentation and CIM, QoE and data pack, model, credit agreement and intercreditor, compliance certificates — and an instinct for where the numbers and the paper disagree.

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling, comfort with prompting and agentic AI workflows, and a builder's instinct for turning a repeated manual process into a repeatable automation. Python, SQL, or experience building internal tools is a plus.

  • Executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility from analysts and associates through to partners and credit committee members.

  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills — comfortable leading a live demo, facilitating a workshop, or holding your own in a technical conversation about a covenant package or an underwriting assumption.

  • Deep curiosity about AI's potential to transform investment work, paired with a practical, solutions-oriented mindset and bias toward action.

  • Track record partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results, with curiosity for testing approaches and optimizing for customer outcomes.

  • Customer-facing or commercial experience (LP or investor relations, capital formation, banking coverage, business development) and/or hands-on experience using AI tools in an investment setting are pluses.

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices here.

raw.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research.

What You'll Do

  • Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

  • Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail.

  • Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows.

  • Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation.

  • Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination.

  • Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most.

  • Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions.

What You Have

  • Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code.

  • A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead.

  • The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria.

  • Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LLM work.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Member of Technical Staff, Modeling in Harvey Research, you’ll own how we adapt and improve leading open-weight models for legal work.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own the post-training recipe across SFT and RL, including reward design and verification for challenging, semi-verifiable legal tasks. You’ll help set the research direction and carry ideas from experiments through training runs to models used by customers. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers and scientists who have gotten training runs working at scale, are immersed in RL for language models, and want their work to reach users quickly.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research.

What You'll Do

  • Own and pursue a research agenda to improve model capability on long-horizon legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

  • Design and run post-training experiments across SFT and RL, building on leading open-weight models.

  • Develop reward functions and verifiers for semi-verifiable tasks, including rubrics, learned preference models, and expert preference data, and study where they break.

  • Run and debug training at scale, addressing divergence, reward hacking, and instability.

  • Build and use rigorous evals to track improvements and decide what ships.

  • Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

What You Have

  • Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with SFT and RL, including preference optimization, and direct ownership of training runs and results.

  • Deep ML fundamentals and experience getting distributed training runs working reliably.

  • Strong engineering skills in Python, with production-quality code and end-to-end system ownership.

  • Research experience in RL for language models or reward modeling, with the ability to move quickly from experiments to shipped improvements. Publications welcome, not required.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.

What You'll Do

  • Scale our post-training stack, supporting SFT and RL on leading open-weight models.

  • Build distributed rollout infrastructure that coordinates model inference, tool execution, and collection of training experience for long-horizon tasks.

  • Build the infrastructure for reproducible agent environments where models can interact with documents, tools, and external systems during training and evaluation.

  • Own the performance and reliability of training runs, including GPU utilization, checkpointing, failure recovery, and observability.

  • Identify and remove bottlenecks across training and inference to shorten the path from research idea to useful result.

  • Build the internal tools and services the team runs on: training data management and versioning, running evals and browsing results, and launching and tracking training jobs and experiments.

  • Integrate models into production, including serving, latency, cost, and online evaluation, so research reaches customers quickly and safely.

  • Partner closely with researchers to turn experimental workflows into dependable systems while keeping room for rapid experimentation.

  • Experience building ML infrastructure, distributed systems, or research tooling, with ownership of performance, reliability, and operation.

  • Strong Python and generalist software engineering skills across backend services, data systems, and internal tools, with familiarity with PyTorch, JAX, or similar ML frameworks.

raw.title: Senior Google Partnerships Growth Director
raw.description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to the Global Google Partnership VP, you will create impact within our Partnerships team. We take pride in our long-standing, market-leading partnership with Google, our deep technical capabilities across their Google ecosystem, and innovative proprietary solutions like Share of Model, setting us apart in the industry.

You'll contribute to accelerating commercial growth across UK and Ireland corporate clients by converting inbound leads, scaling reseller adoption across the Google stack, and championing proprietary tools. A distinct and unique aspect of this role includes collaborating on-site at Google’s London headquarters, cultivating senior stakeholder relationships across their product lines to unlock joint funding and commercial initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Inbound Lead Management and Conversion

    • Qualify, lead, and convert inbound opportunities and major enterprise pitches across the UK and Ireland originating from Google and partnership channels.

    • Partner with the UK Head of Growth, tech specialists, and commercial teams to run discovery sessions and deliver compelling, tailored client proposals.

  • Partner-Led Growth

    • Act as an embedded Growth Partner by spending regular time at Google’s London headquarters, building active networks across Google sales, sector, and product specialists.

    • Identify, secure, and deploy Google partner funding programs to unlock joint commercial initiatives and accelerate platform adoption.

  • Existing Client Growth and Expansion

    • Drive upsell and cross-sell revenue across our existing reseller client base, expanding adoption of the Google stack (GMP, DV360, GA, GTM).

    • Collaborate with Account Management and Martech teams to commercialise proprietary Jellyfish solutions, including Share of Model, into client growth strategies.

  • Commercial Execution and Performance

    • Take ownership of commercial negotiations from qualification through contract close and handover, maintaining pipeline governance and sales forecasting in Salesforce.

    • Track growth KPIs, funding drawdown, and commercial performance while staying current on Google ecosystem updates to identify emerging opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Track record in partnership growth, commercial business development, or consultative selling, with a good commercial understanding of Google technologies (Google Marketing Platform, DV360, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager) or a comparable enterprise technology stack (e.g., Amazon, Meta, or TikTok).

  • Ability to uncover enterprise client objectives, articulate commercial value propositions, and convey product benefits to corporate decision-makers.

  • Experience establishing credible, productive working relationships with technology partner teams, as well as internal technical and account management functions.

  • Commercial intelligence building custom commercial proposals, navigating contract negotiations, and maximizing partner-funded growth programs.

  • Proficiency using enterprise CRMs to govern pipeline stages, manage deals, and deliver accurate sales forecasting.

  • You generate unique ideas and experiment with new methods and technologies to solve complex issues.

  • You embrace challenges as opportunities, and when faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options and find practical solutions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Engineering Manager - Product Engineering
raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As an Engineering Manager at Legora, you’ll lead by example—hands-on in the code while guiding a talented team of engineers. You’ll architect and deliver features that make legal professionals’ lives easier, drive technical excellence, and help shape a product used by forward-thinking law firms around the world. This is a role for someone who loves to build, mentor, and scale both people and systems.

What you will be doing:

  • Design and implement end-to-end features across our fullstack platform

  • Contribute directly to the codebase while supporting the growth of your team

  • Lead architecture discussions and technical decision-making

  • Ensure high standards in code quality, security, and performance

  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to ship value quickly and reliably

  • Review code, give feedback, and mentor engineers at all levels

  • Champion best practices in development, DevOps, and continuous improvement

  • Work with Node.js, React, Azure, AWS and Kubernetes

  • Work every day to ensure your team is healthy and efficient

Who you are

  • A seasoned fullstack or backend engineer with 1-3 years of leadership experience

  • Comfortable being hands-on while also setting technical direction

  • Skilled in building scalable products and owning complex systems end-to-end

  • Strong communicator who leads with empathy and clarity

  • Passionate about mentoring others and helping teams grow

  • Confident working across backend, frontend, and infrastructure

  • Curious, pragmatic, and always looking for smarter ways to build and deliver

  • But most importantly, you are someone who:

    • “Gets stuff done” and understands building a successful company isn’t always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours

    • Proactively and independently solves the most burning problems

    • Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren’t always clear and processes are few

*Candidates will go through the same interview process as software engineering candidates (including a coding task and a technical interview), with additional interview steps at the end designed for the engineering manager role.

*This is a London Based, 5-day in-office role, we believe building together in person drives better outcomes.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Product velocity depends on having the right engineering and technical talent in place, fast, and at a high bar. As a Talent Partner, you will own that directly. raw.title: Director of International Product
raw.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

Lyra is looking for a visionary and strategic Director, International Product to lead and scale our global mental health offerings. As Lyra grows around the world, you’ll shape how we deliver high-quality, culturally relevant care to members, providers, and employers in every market we serve.

You’ll serve as the connective tissue between our global commercial ambitions and technical execution, guiding multiple simultaneous initiatives and building a platform-first, repeatable engine for international growth. Working alongside senior leadership, you’ll own the strategic vision, delivery, and performance of the international product suite.

The leaders who thrive in this role pair high standards with real care for the people around them. They build strong relationships across the organization, earn influence through trust and clarity, and bring steady, energizing leadership to their teams, especially when the path ahead is uncertain


What You'll Do:
  • Global Product Vision & Strategy: Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for Lyra’s international product suite, grounded in market analysis, competitive insight, and firsthand understanding of the members, providers, and clients we serve in each region. Synthesize global market signals into a clear point of view on where to invest for the greatest impact for global employers.
  • Product Scope & Ownership: Hold full lifecycle responsibility for the scoping, development, and delivery of member experiences and the underlying platform infrastructure across four major product lines: International Lyra Workforce Mental Health (WFMH), Global Lyra Wellbeing, 10 Local Lyra Wellbeing products, and other product surface areas as needed.
  • Platform-First Scale: Lead the evolution of our international offerings onto a unified global platform, with automated workflows that make each new client launch faster and more repeatable than the last. Champion the localization of core capabilities, including billing, eligibility, and provider management, so they flex gracefully across markets.
  • Roadmap Stewardship: Balance the needs of today’s clients with durable, long-term platform investments. Make clear, well-reasoned tradeoffs, explain the “why” behind them in a way that brings people along, and have the conviction to say “not yet” when that’s what best serves members and the business.
  • Leadership & Team Development: Build and lead the International Product team. Hire and grow exceptional people, including leaders whose strengths go beyond your own, and invest in their development through candid, caring feedback and meaningful ownership. Your success is measured by how well your team thrives: clearing the path, providing context, and creating the conditions for others to do their best work.
  • Business Ownership & Resourcing: Create and manage the annual budget for International Product. Assess resourcing needs and build compelling business cases to secure the investment needed to reach ambitious growth targets.
  • Cost-to-Serve & Performance Insight: Partner with the Data organization to build a single, trusted view of international performance, giving leadership clear visibility into margins, ROI, and utilization. Define and track the product metrics that measure success, and identify opportunities to streamline and automate so global products are built for long-term profitability.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the central connector across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Clinical Governance, Legal, and Compliance. Build trusted relationships across regions and time zones, including in our local operations work toward win-win outcomes amid competing priorities, and ensure clinical quality and local regulatory requirements are built into the product lifecycle from the start.
  • Go-To-Market Partnership: Act as a trusted partner to Go-To-Market and Client Services teams. Serve as the product voice in high-stakes, C-level client conversations and complex RFPs, bringing the technical and clinical confidence that helps Lyra win and retain large-scale global contracts.
  • AI-Enabled Product Excellence: Maintain a high bar for product craft and apply AI with purpose, both in our products, where it can meaningfully expand access and improve care, and in how we work. Model how AI can accelerate research, synthesis, planning, and execution, and help your team adopt tools and practices that drive efficiency, effectiveness, and happiness.

    • What You'll Bring:
  • Experience: Several years in product management, strategy, or technical operations.
  • Leadership: Several years of people leadership, with a track record of building strong teams and coaching talent to grow beyond their current roles.
  • Global Product Expertise: Experience launching and scaling products across multiple countries, including localizing for language, culture, and care norms, and navigating regional privacy and regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, data residency). A natural instinct to design for local context, informed by real cultural fluency.
  • Platform & Enterprise Architecture: Deep understanding of bringing multiple systems together onto a unified global platform and reducing the effort required for each new client launch.
  • Commercial & Financial Acumen: Advanced skills in multivariable planning, budget ownership, and resource forecasting in a complex, matrixed environment. You think like a business owner and use data on product health, margin, ROI, and utilization to guide strategy.
  • Executive Influence & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can distill complexity into a crisp narrative, write a document that drives a decision, and adapt your message for engineers, clinicians, and C-level executives alike. A demonstrated track record of influencing senior leaders and key external stakeholders through credibility and trust, along with strong negotiation skills.
  • High Performance under Complexity: Ability to analyze changing, multivariable situations and set objectives with high impact on company goals. You make sound calls with incomplete information, move comfortably between the details and the big picture, keep momentum when plans shift, and stay composed and solutions-oriented when headwinds arise.
  • Practical AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using AI to meaningfully accelerate your own work and your team’s, with the discernment to know where it adds real value.
  • Culture & Psychological Safety: A model of Lyra’s values who fosters psychological safety across the team, welcomes nuanced feedback, and makes it safe for team members to voice differing opinions. You hold strong opinions loosely, change your mind when the evidence warrants, and share credit freely.
  • Mission & People Focus: A passion for Lyra’s mission. Your curiosity and empathy come naturally: they show up in the questions you ask, the time you spend with members, providers, and clients, and the products you build as a result.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (or international equivalent) required; MBA or equivalent professional experience preferred.

About Lyra
 
Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Opportunity
 

Lyra’s provider network is composed of in-person and virtual therapists, physicians, and coaches across the US. With our advanced matching technology, supportive provider platform, and opportunities for training and clinical consultation, being part of our network is an incredible chance to do what you love (like patient care) with support for the things you don’t love (like self promotion and scheduling).

As a contract Child and Adolescent nurse practitioner, you will provide essential clinical care. This role emphasizes core competencies such as diagnostic expertise, family engagement, ethical practice, and continuous improvement to ensure the highest standard of care.

You’ll provide evidence-based treatment via live 30-minute video intake appointments and regular follow-up appointments. You'll conduct psychiatric evaluations and provide medication management. Lyra makes it easy to refer patients to evidence-based therapy and coaching services in tandem with your care.

 

You will provide care to children, teens, and young adults from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, as well as those with varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally-responsive care—an approach that is mindful of the impact of cultural background on each person’s care experience.


Responsibilities:
  • Practice comprehensive mental health medication management via a 60-minute intake appointment and regular follow-up appointments
  • Conduct mental health risk assessments, psychiatric medication evaluations, and longitudinal medication treatment
  • Construct patient-centered treatment plans, document treatment recommendations, message patients, and prescribe and manage psychiatric medications
  • Experience and commitment to providing safe, evidence-based medication treatment that follows clinical best practice guidelines (e.g., measurement based care, patient-centered care, paying close attention, medication minimizing risks, and maximizing benefits)

    • Requirements:
  • Graduate from an accredited (CCNE) Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) program; OR graduate from an accredited PA program (ARC-PA) with certification through PANCE with preference for Certificate of Added Qualifications in psychiatry, post-graduate fellowship in psychiatry, or other academic psychiatry certificate program completion, including a Doctor of Medical Science with Psychiatry concentration
  • Unrestricted state license
  • A minimum of 2 years in practice
  • Strong preference for NPs and PA-Cs with an active DEA license
  • Preference for NPs and PA-Cs with additional certification or clinical experience with minors
  • Must have office space with ability to see clients in Williamsport
  • Ability to provide care to patients with a full range of diagnoses, clinical complexity, and severity levels, with a preference for providers who offer in-person options
  • Full-time resident of the United States

    • Here are some of the advantages of joining the Lyra provider network:
  • Set your own schedule without a minimum hours requirement 
  • Focus less on the administrative burden of billing with Lyra’s paperless billing and quick payment turnaround 
  • Access to a custom-built calendar for new patients to connect seamlessly
  • Access to experienced clinical consultations to get rapid support with your patients as well as access a range of specialty group consultation meetings 
  • Have peace of mind with Lyra’s 24/7 Care Navigation team for client crisis support

The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Opportunity
 

Lyra’s provider network is composed of in-person and virtual therapists, physicians, and coaches across the US. With our advanced matching technology, supportive provider platform, and opportunities for training and clinical consultation, being part of our network is an incredible chance to do what you love (like patient care) with support for the things you don’t love (like self promotion and scheduling).

As a contract Child and Adolescent nurse practitioner, you will provide essential clinical care. This role emphasizes core competencies such as diagnostic expertise, family engagement, ethical practice, and continuous improvement to ensure the highest standard of care.

You’ll provide evidence-based treatment via live 30-minute video intake appointments and regular follow-up appointments. You'll conduct psychiatric evaluations and provide medication management. Lyra makes it easy to refer patients to evidence-based therapy and coaching services in tandem with your care.

 

You will provide care to children, teens, and young adults from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, as well as those with varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally-responsive care—an approach that is mindful of the impact of cultural background on each person’s care experience.


Responsibilities:
  • Practice comprehensive mental health medication management via a 60-minute intake appointment and regular follow-up appointments
  • Conduct mental health risk assessments, psychiatric medication evaluations, and longitudinal medication treatment
  • Construct patient-centered treatment plans, document treatment recommendations, message patients, and prescribe and manage psychiatric medications
  • Experience and commitment to providing safe, evidence-based medication treatment that follows clinical best practice guidelines (e.g., measurement based care, patient-centered care, paying close attention, medication minimizing risks, and maximizing benefits)

    • Requirements:
  • Graduate from an accredited (CCNE) Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) program; OR graduate from an accredited PA program (ARC-PA) with certification through PANCE with preference for Certificate of Added Qualifications in psychiatry, post-graduate fellowship in psychiatry, or other academic psychiatry certificate program completion, including a Doctor of Medical Science with Psychiatry concentration
  • Unrestricted state license
  • A minimum of 2 years in practice
  • Strong preference for NPs and PA-Cs with an active DEA license
  • Preference for NPs and PA-Cs with additional certification or clinical experience with minors
  • Must have office space with ability to see clients in Williamsport
  • Ability to provide care to patients with a full range of diagnoses, clinical complexity, and severity levels, with a preference for providers who offer in-person options
  • Full-time resident of the United States

    • Here are some of the advantages of joining the Lyra provider network:
  • Set your own schedule without a minimum hours requirement 
  • Focus less on the administrative burden of billing with Lyra’s paperless billing and quick payment turnaround 
  • Access to a custom-built calendar for new patients to connect seamlessly
  • Access to experienced clinical consultations to get rapid support with your patients as well as access a range of specialty group consultation meetings 
  • Have peace of mind with Lyra’s 24/7 Care Navigation team for client crisis support

raw.description:
We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. 
Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 

Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.

And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers. And building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system.

We’re made up of 10,000+ authentic, committed people working around the world on stuff you'd never expect. We're united by a shared goal: to drive the global green energy revolution. Read our Spotlight series to meet some of the team.

About the role

At Octopus Tech, you’ll have real ownership, variety, and the chance to shape products that make a tangible difference in people’s lives - lowering bills, enabling greener living, and delivering experiences customers genuinely love. You’ll work side by side with teams across marketing, operations, and data, and see the impact of your work in the real world, fast.
 
We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Global Backend Team.
 
The Global Backend Team are the powerhouse behind our mission to build the future of energy tech, working on our new and rapidly growing backend retail codebase used by all Octopus Energy engineering teams around the world.
 
We embrace flat hierarchies and an open, agile culture that fosters innovation, flexibility, and creativity. 
 
We don’t hang our personalities up with our coats and nor should you. At Octopus, we hire great people who get stuff done, all whilst being themselves.
 
If this sounds exciting, we’d love to chat.

What you'll have
We're looking for someone with a general interest in technology and problem-solving; someone diligent and thoughtful. It would be helpful to have experience/expertise in the following (in rough priority order):
  • Python
  • Django (or equiv. web framework)
  • Domain modelling
  • GraphQL
  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software
  • Celery and async processing
  • Postgres
    • Plus experience in the following would be a bonus:
  • AWS
  • Kubernetes
    • We would prefer someone who can work in our London office but will consider remote candidates. However, you do need to be able to work in the UK.
     

    Why else you'll love it here

    • Wondering what the salary for this role is? Once you're in the interview process with one of our recruiters, it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
    • Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were named the UK's top company to work for in 2025, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
    • Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
     
    If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you, tell us what you care about, why Octopus feels right and most importantly, bring us the real you! Applying for jobs can be a bit scary so have a nose through some of our tips first 🚀
     
    P.S. Our process usually takes up to 4 weeks, but we’ll always do our best to flex around what works for you. Along the way, you’ll chat with our recruitment team and your Recruiter will help you throughout different stages. Got any burning questions before then? Drop us a message at ----- and we’d love to help!
     
    Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
     
    Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.
